title: Senior Project Development Manager, Brazil - Battery Storage
description:
Company Overview

Plus Power is an energy storage market leader, with a market‑leading 10+ GW portfolio across more than 25 states that will transform North American electric grids into cleaner and more versatile critical infrastructure.

About the Role

Plus Power recruits outstanding energy industry professionals who are driven to develop, build and operate assets safely and reliably to decarbonize the power markets while growing their careers. Our team looks for data‑driven and fact‑based mindsets, engaging and collaborative behaviors, and personal growth‑focused professionals.

Plus Power is looking to hire a Project Development Senior Manager to be a functional lead of projects within Plus Power's portfolio. The Project Development Senior Manager will own the ultimate responsibility for de‑risking a portfolio of projects in Brazil. The Project Development Manager will have a sophisticated team of subject matter experts who will provide support for specific discrete deliverables such as cost estimates, interconnection process navigation, procurement and operations, however the ultimate responsibility of this position is to lead a cross‑functional team to bring a portfolio of projects to Notice to Proceed (NTP).

Key Responsibilities

  • Collaborate with local Brazilian partners to ensure workflow is efficient and expeditiously completed.
  • Site Acquisition and Due Diligence: Partner with stakeholders to identify and secure project sites that maximize off‑take potential, ensuring adherence to internal processes and completion of diligence requirements.
  • Project Development: Manage a project pipeline and execute on complex milestone deliverables across a network of stakeholders.
  • Project Management: Own complex site, permitting, and technology problem‑solving efforts, leveraging internal expertise and external stakeholder engagement to keep projects on track.
  • Project Finance: Understand the key financing elements of a project and work with the finance and commercial teams to ensure that all projects and deals continue to meet or exceed financial hurdles.
  • Contract Origination: Partner with Markets and Origination teams to identify and quantify commercial opportunities and support RFP submissions.
  • Commercial Negotiation: Support cross‑functional stakeholders in negotiating power purchase agreements, permitting documents, interconnection agreements, and related commercial contracts to protect project and development objectives; support financing activities associated with new deals.
  • Deal Execution: Provide support in closing and financing each new deal.

Skills & Qualifications

  • Minimum BA/BS in economics, finance, business, or related field.
  • 10+ years of experience in project development focused on transmission‑connected generators in Brazil.
  • Preference is for this role to be based in Brazil.
  • Familiarity with the Brazilian power market, ONS and EPE rules and dynamics.
  • Experience supporting full lifecycle development of a transmission‑connected generation asset in Brazil.
  • Experience participating in the development of or completing all of the following agreement types:
  • • Site lease or purchase agreements
  • • Site Plan and Building Permit approvals
  • • Interconnection agreements
  • • Power purchase or tolling agreements
  • • MIPA / PSA for project disposition / acquisition
  • Creative independent thinker; demonstrated ability to work both independently and as part of a diverse team.
  • Adept at working collaboratively and effectively in a cross‑functional environment with both technical and non‑technical team members who are geographically dispersed.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects in a dynamic, fast paced environment.
  • Ability to think creatively, bringing innovative ideas and solutions to complex challenges.
  • Highly organized with impeccable attention to detail.
  • Ability to effectively manage multiple priorities and deliver timely, high‑quality results.Excellent presentation and communication skills, with the ability to convey complex information clearly and confidently to diverse audiences, including senior leadership and external stakeholders.
  • Ability to travel as needed to successfully advance and contract a portfolio of projects, including stakeholder meetings, site visits, and related activities.

Compensation, Location, and Benefits

Highly competitive total compensation from one of North America's leading energy storage developers, owners and operators. Flexible, work from home or hybrid work from Plus Power's offices in San Francisco, Houston, Chicago, Seattle, and Palm Beach.

We may ultimately pay more or less than the posted range based on several factors including, but not limited to relevant experience, skills, qualifications, geographic labor market, and other factors consistent with applicable law. This position is also eligible to participate in our annual bonus program.

Plus Power offers a competitive and comprehensive benefits program, unlimited vacation, flexible remote work, work from home stipend, educational assistance, parental leave, and a highly engaging company culture with opportunities for in‑person connection and learning and growth.

The deadline for applying to this role is 1/05/2026.

Plus Power is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace where people of all backgrounds can thrive. Plus Power is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, or other legally protected status.

title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description:
Enterprise Sales Manager

Job Purpose

The Enterprise Sales Manager is responsible for driving new revenue growth through proactive outreach, prospecting, and pipeline development, while also expanding existing enterprise customer relationships. Leads will be generated through multiple channels, including marketing campaigns, third‑party lead generation, and self‑sourced outreach.

An Enterprise customer is defined as any organisation with 200+ white‑collar employees, and the role will span both national and international client requirements, depending on account footprint and opportunity scope.

This role plays a critical part in positioning IWG’s full suite of solutions to large organisations across multiple markets.

Key Responsibilities

  • Generate profitable new revenue by identifying, prospecting, and converting new Enterprise clients.
  • Develop and maintain a robust pipeline of qualified sales opportunities across multiple sectors and geographies.
  • Conduct strategic outreach through direct engagement, events, and third‑party referrals to identify high‑potential prospects.
  • Own the full sales cycle — from first contact to close — with an emphasis on front‑end activity and deal progression.
  • Create and execute Account Plans to grow wallet share within assigned strategic accounts.
  • Build and maintain executive‑level relationships to gain insight into client needs and translate insights into tailored workspace solutions.
  • Collaborate with brokers, real estate advisors, and consultants to generate opportunities and increase IWG’s market visibility.
  • Partner cross‑functionally with regional Sales, Operations, and Product teams to ensure seamless solution delivery.
  • Continuously gather and share feedback from prospects and clients to improve product‑market fit and go‑to‑market effectiveness.
  • Deliver accurate pipeline forecasts, activity reports, and performance updates.

Required Skills, Experience & Qualifications

  • Proven track record in B2B prospecting, business development, and solution selling.
  • Ability to independently source and qualify leads in complex, consultative sales environments.
  • Strong understanding of the enterprise customer buying journey and long‑cycle deal management.
  • Experience working with and influencing C‑level stakeholders.
  • Background in commercial real estate, enterprise services, or flexible workspace is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated ability to meet and exceed sales targets through self‑generated pipeline.
  • Strong negotiation and contract structuring skills.
  • High level of commercial acumen and results orientation.
  • Comfortable working in global, matrixed organisations with distributed teams.
  • Adaptable, proactive, and confident navigating ambiguity.
  • Willingness to travel internationally as needed.
  • Native Portuguese and fluent/conversational English

About the company

IWG has been at the forefront of flexible working for more than 30 years. With over 3,500 locations around the globe, spanning brands including Regus, Spaces, Signature and HQ, we have made it possible for businesses of all sizes to make the transition to hybrid working, empowering employees to work wherever and whenever is most convenient.

We help more than 8 million people and their businesses to work more productively, supported by a choice of professional, inspiring and collaborative workspaces, communities and services.

As the world’s leading provider of hybrid work solutions, with four times the number of locations compared to its nearest competitor, IWG is already working with over 80% of the Fortune 500 and counts businesses including Amazon, Netflix, EY and Uber amongst its customers.

Companies of all sizes are shifting to flexible working to lower costs, improve employee retention and lower their carbon emissions. The flexible workspace is expected to grow by 600% by 2023, when 30% of all office space will be hybrid. We are growing our network faster than ever to keep up with demand from customers as we work towards our goal of reaching 30,000 centres.

Carbon Neutral Workplaces

IWG’s purpose of helping everyone have a great day at work, while protecting people and the planet is at the heart of everything we do. We are proud to supply all of our customers worldwide with carbon neutral workplaces, and we have a strong climate action plan in place to help us achieve our objective of Net Zero emissions by 2040.

Leading Employer Award IWG is proud to be the recipient of a Leading Employer Award in 2022, 2023, 2024 & 2025. Awarded exclusively to the top 1% of employers, the accolade is testament to our diverse global workforce and the role everyone plays in bringing our purpose, culture and values to life, every single day.

A key part of this role is leading the regional Sales, Support, and Technical teams, ensuring alignment, motivation, and performance across functions. title: Video Editor
description:
About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. We were founded in 2017 out of a conviction that the iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different. Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across the various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results-driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

As an Editor at Darkroom, your primary duty will be to develop and assist in the development of marketing collateral, including video content and organic content. Our Editors add immense value to our client's work through native content and strategies. The ideal candidate is someone who is passionate about using their editing skills to tell a compelling story and help our customers grow their businesses.

This is a fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and is open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, and Spain.

Who You Are:

  • Experience creating platform native content (including video content and organic content), especially IG Reels, Meta ads, and TikTok viral video campaigns

  • Exceptional time management and organization skills with the ability to manage deliverables across an array of brands

  • Strong Motion Graphics/ Graphic Design/ Typography skills required

  • Proficient in Adobe Premiere Pro + FCPX

  • Working knowledge of Adobe Creative Suite (especially Media Encoder, After Effects, Premiere, and Photoshop)

  • Familiarity with broadcast finishing workflows (mix, color, VFX, conform, online)

  • Familiarity working in a networked server environment

  • Strong technical knowledge of codecs and transcoding practices

  • Strong time management skills and ability to work in a fast-paced environment

  • Strong communication skills

  • Proficient with animation/ graphic design preferred

What You'll Do:

  • You will be editing UGC-style videos in a variety of content formats

  • Develop and execute thumb-stopping social media video edits, layer audio seamlessly and overlay text that drives key brand messaging

  • Brainstorm inventive edits and hooks that drive engagement, leverage new formats

  • Stay current on all social media platforms, ad offerings, content publishers, tools, trends, and best practices

  • Be a creative collaborator: Have the ability to be the voice of the brand and the influencer to create content that is authentic and powerful for all channels

  • Be comfortable using video editing software, editing audio, and taking editing direction, while working in a fast pace environment

  • Provide accessible content that includes closed captioning, voiceover, and overlay text in a variety of aspect ratios

  • Setting up projects for edit staff

  • Ingesting and logging footage

  • Working in tandem with edit staff to meet deadlines

  • Editing lower-level projects

  • Maintaining media storage (hard drives, servers, GDrive)

  • Mastering deliverables and archiving projects

  • Assisting senior staff with edit and administrative needs

  • Versioning various aspect ratios of completed edits

  • Maintaining all software and assets (Mac OSX, server operating system, frame.io, Vimeo, shared assets)

  • Coordinating and troubleshooting edit equipment

  • Reporting to the Post-Production Supervisor and Producers, the AE will upon request create high-quality video edits that will span various media platforms

  • Performance creative editing (collaborating with the performance marketing team in reviewing ad analytics/performance)

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world-class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Location, location, (or no) location: Remote-first culture with a strong community base. With Hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, Sao Paulo, and Barcelona!

  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work-life balance.

  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross-functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements

title: ANALISTA SISTEMAS - HOSPITAL CARDOSO FONTES
description:
A SPDM - Associação Paulista para o Desenvolvimento da Medicina é uma Associação civil sem fins lucrativos, de natureza filantrópica, reconhecida de utilidade pública federal, estadual e no município de sua sede, respectivamente pelos decretos nos. 57.925, de 04 / 03 / 1966, 40.103 de 17 / 05 / 1962 e 8.911, de 30 / 07 / 1970.

A Instituição atua nos âmbitos federal, estadual e municipal, em harmonia com suas políticas de saúde e de educação, e também como organização social habilitada em vários estados, na gerência de serviços e organizações de saúde, por meio de convênios e contratos de gestão.

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Com o crescimento Institucional, a SPDM vem expandindo sua área de atuação com projetos, em desenvolvimento, na área da Assistência Social e na área Educacional. Toda essa gama de atividades consolida, cada vez mais, a SPDM como uma instituição filantrópica de grande porte, que busca a sustentabilidade econômica, social e ambiental.

Suas quatro superintendências - Hospital São Paulo, Instituições Afiliadas, Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde (PAIS) e Educação - são gerenciadas por profissionais de alta capacitação técnica e notável saber.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão. Para tanto, associa o melhor da tecnologia com atendimento médico de alta qualidade, respaldado por equipes multiprofissionais, formadas por enfermeiros, fisioterapeutas, farmacêuticos, nutricionistas, fonoaudiólogos, bioquímicos, psicólogos, tecnólogos, assistentes sociais e dentistas, entre outros.

O Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde iniciou suas atividades no ano de 2001 no município de São Paulo, se estendendo para outros municípios e estados. Desde o início de suas atividades, o PAIS busca, em parceria com a gestão pública, o crescimento e a consolidação dos serviços de saúde ofertados aos usuários do SUS.

O Programa tem como objetivo garantir mudanças nos indicadores e na qualidade de vida da população, pautado, entre outros, pelos princípios da integralidade e da equidade, com uma visão estratégica da gestão dos serviços de saúde, definida em um processo de aprimoramento contínuo.

Inclusão

A SPDM oferece oportunidades de trabalho em suas unidades hospitalares, com plano de carreira, para pessoas com deficiência. Para tanto, periodicamente publica anúncio recrutando esses profissionais, nos principais jornais de São Paulo e dos municípios em que se localizam suas unidades.

Missão

Promover ações em saúde integradas com a gestão pública, em benefício da população de forma ética e humanizada, qualidade técnica, com compromisso social e ambiental.

Visão

Ser referência em gestão de serviços em saúde, abrangendo todos os níveis da assistência, garantindo atendimento com qualidade à população dos municípios e estados parceiros.

Valores

  • Profissionalismo
  • Qualidade
  • Responsabilidade Social
  • Trabalho em equipe
  • Ética

Ensino Superior Completo em Engenharia da Computação, Ciências da Computação e áreas afins. Pós-Graduação na área de atuação.

Experiência de 6 meses na função.

Ser responsável pelo alinhamento entre as áreas de negócios e Tecnologia e Informação. Oferecer suporte aos usuários quanto ao uso de sistemas. Realizar análises e correções em sistemas. Analisar as solicitações e acompanhamento das empresas terceirizadas. Dimensionar requisitos e funcionalidades do sistema. Desenvolver relatórios a partir dos bancos de dados dos sistemas.

title: Compliance Analyst
description:
About Crown

We exist to make money work better. That means eliminating the friction of integrating the Brazilian Real into the blockchain economy without sacrificing trust, safety, or compliance.

With the conviction that programmable money is the future of finance, we built BRLV . Anchored by a 1:1 backing of sovereign Brazilian treasury assets, BRLV is the safe, scalable settlement layer designed for the tokenized economy.

We’re backed by Framework, Valor, Norte, Coinbase Ventures, Paxos, and Nubank co‑founder Ed Wible. Our goal: R$1 trillion of BRLV in circulation within 10 years.

The Role

As a Compliance Analyst at Crown, you will be a cornerstone of our risk management framework, operating across both the first and second lines of defense. You will serve as the primary compliance liaison for our institutional clients and partners, guiding them through our rigorous due diligence process while performing critical risk analysis to protect the firm. This role requires a unique blend of client‑facing communication skills and deep analytical rigor. You will work directly with the Chief Compliance Officer and the broader risk function to implement and uphold our institutional‑grade AML/CFT Policy.

  • Institutional Onboarding (1st Line): Act as the main point of contact for institutional clients during the entire onboarding lifecycle. You will guide them through the appropriate Due Diligence Questionnaire (for Brazilian, U.S., or other non‑U.S. entities), ensuring all mandatory documentation—such as constitutional documents, AML/CFT policies, and ownership charts—is collected completely and accurately.
  • Customer Due Diligence (CDD) and Risk Assessment (2nd Line): Conduct comprehensive reviews of prospective clients, applying our risk‑based approach. This includes analyzing complex corporate structures to identify and verify Ultimate Beneficial Owners (UBOs) according to our dynamic thresholds.
  • Enhanced Due Diligence (EDD): Execute enhanced due diligence for high‑risk clients, including Politically Exposed Persons (PEPs), VASPs, and other financial institutions. This involves a critical assessment of the client’s own AML program, their independent audit reports, and the source of their funds and wealth.
  • Transaction Monitoring Support (2nd Line): Assist in the analysis of alerts generated by our on‑chain and fiat transaction monitoring systems. You will investigate atypical activity, adhering to strict internal SLAs for resolution (e.g., 24 hours for critical alerts), and prepare dossiers for potential Suspicious Transaction Reports (STRs) to be submitted to COAF.
  • Record Keeping and Data Protection: Ensure all due diligence, risk assessments, and client communications are meticulously documented and securely stored, in compliance with our policies and regulatory requirements. You will handle highly sensitive client data and must adhere strictly to our Information Security Policy and data protection principles (LGPD).

You Might Be a Fit If...

  • You have 3+ years of experience in a compliance, KYC/AML, risk, or client onboarding role within a VASP, fintech, or regulated financial institution.
  • You have a deep and practical understanding of Brazilian AML/CFT regulations (e.g., Law 14.478/22, COAF reporting) and are familiar with international FATF standards.
  • You are fluent in both Portuguese and English, with exceptional written and verbal communication skills required to interact with sophisticated institutional clients and internal stakeholders.
  • You have a highly analytical mindset and an obsessive attention to detail, capable of dissecting complex legal and corporate structures to identify underlying risks.
  • You thrive in ownership-driven environments. You’re highly accountable for your work and don’t require others following up on it.
  • You naturally operate cross-functionally, with strong collaborative instincts toward legal, operations, and technology teams.
  • You are energized by the challenge of building and refining compliance processes from the ground up in a fast-paced environment.

What’s Different About Working Here

  • Small by design. We don’t hire layers of managers. Everyone builds.
  • Ownership is total. You own the function end‑to‑end—and ask for input when it makes the work better, not because someone’s checking.
  • Ruthlessly simple. We don’t paper over complexity with process or headcount.
  • Collaboration is default. Problems are shared property. We work across domains.
  • Feedback is candid and direct. Built on the assumption that everyone here is smart, competent, and cares.

Compensation

  • Competitive salary
  • Full health coverage
  • VA

title: Roaming IREG Engineer
description:
1 week ago Be among the first 25 applicants

1GLOBAL is a technology-driven global mobile communications provider dedicated to empowering enterprises worldwide to unlock the full growth potential of mobile connectivity. With a best-in-class telecom technology platform, a comprehensive suite of globally viable regulatory licenses, and privileged access to the telecom wholesale market, 1GLOBAL is uniquely positioned to deliver seamless compliance and connectivity solutions. Serving the world's leading banks, corporations, and digital-first businesses—including neo-banks, travel companies, and payment service providers—1GLOBAL connects over 43 million devices globally.

With 2024 full-year revenue exceeding US$100 million and in line to exceed US$200 million in FY25, 1GLOBAL is a profitable business generating significant cash flows to fund its ongoing investments in infrastructure, transformation, and growth. 2024 saw major client wins and marked 1GLOBAL's evolution from a multi-market telecommunication provider to a global technology-driven mobile connectivity powerhouse.

Established in 2022 by experienced tech founders and entrepreneurs Hakan Koç and Pyrros Koussios, 1GLOBAL is a European technology leader driving digital transformation in the global telecommunications market. It operates as a fully regulated Mobile Virtual Network Operator ("MVNO") in ten countries and as a regulated telecommunications operator in an additional 31 countries. Headquartered in the Netherlands, with world-class R&D hubs in Lisbon, Berlin, and São Paulo, 1GLOBAL employs over 450 experts across 15 countries.

Position Overview

1Global is seeking a talented and detail-oriented RoamingIREG Engineer to manage the entire roaming process and procedures. As an IREG Engineer you will be responsible for the technical setup, testing, and maintenance of international roaming and interconnect services.

We're looking for a proactive individual with a strong technical foundation, adept at troubleshooting support cases and enhancing operational processes for seamless footprint updates.

Key Responsibilities

  • Plan, execute, and document IREG tests (IR.24, IR.35, IR.50, etc.) for voice, SMS, and data services, in line with GSMA standards
  • Set up and verify interconnect links for voice and messaging services with partner operators
  • Monitor roaming service KPIs, troubleshoot issues, and ensure compliance with roaming agreements
  • Configure and test SS7, Diameter, SIP, and related signaling protocols for international connectivity
  • Liaise with foreign operators, roaming hubs, and internal teams during implementation and troubleshooting
  • Maintain up-to-date test results, network configurations, and operational procedures
  • Oversee the footprint management of all 1Global products, working closely with the wholesale and other networks team

Requirements

Must Have

  • Perform end-to-end roaming testing (voice, SMS, data, CAMEL, VoLTE, 5G roaming)
  • Execute IREG test cases according to GSMA guidelines and bilateral agreements
  • Analyze and troubleshoot roaming issues with signaling traces and logs
  • Work closely with international roaming partners to resolve interconnect problems
  • Manage and update roaming documentation (IR.21)
  • Support new roaming launches (testing and activation of new operators, technologies, and services)
  • Coordinate with internal teams (Core Network, Billing, etc) during testing and troubleshooting
  • Validate TAP files and charging/billing aspects of roaming services
  • Monitor KPIs and performance of roaming services after launch
  • Follow-up and define Quality and Performance indicators for the entire roaming service
  • Close relationship with external partners like carriers, service providers
  • Have successful partnerships with other departments and teams

Qualifications

  • Degree in Telecom Engineering or Computer Science or equivalent experience
  • Knowledge of 3GPP, ETSI, standards and specifications for SIM/eSIM
  • Knowledge and experience with protocols such as MAP, S6a
  • Familiar with an RSP architecture and experience operating it
  • Knowledge in scripting and have basic programming skills
  • Experience with protocol analyzer tools like Wireshark, Astelia, and ability to use them to troubleshoot network errors/problems for the mentioned protocols
  • Experience with ETSI NFV architecture and solutions
  • Familiar with MVNO/MVNE/MVNA architecture(s) and landscape

Benefits

  • CLT contract — enjoy job stability and reliable benefits that value your work
  • Quarterly performance bonuses — to reward your hard work and achievements
  • Meal allowance paid into Caju card — R$100 per working day
  • Health insurance with SulAmérica — 50% covered by the company
  • Daycare allowance provided to mothers with children under 3 years old — R$500 per month per child
  • Kickstart your journey with an exciting welcome onboarding trip to one of our European offices (Lisbon or Berlin)

Why 1GLOBAL?

  • Growth Opportunities: Advance your career in one of the fastest growing telecommunications companies, expanding over 100% year-on-year under the leadership of successful tech entrepreneurs
  • Major Transaction Exposure: Be in the driver's seat for transactions that will have an impact on the future telco industry
  • Work with a Talented Team: From the Board and the Founders to the Senior Management Team, you will collaborate daily with the most capable and renowned external advisors, and constantly being exposed to talented and driven individuals
  • Dynamic Work Environment: Thrive in a collaborative, fast-paced workplace where innovation is encouraged, and every contribution counts
  • Professional Development: Work alongside industry experts to enhance your skills and knowledge in a cutting-edge field
  • International Experience: Gain opportunities to work in different 1GLOBAL offices around the world as you grow within the company
  • Open Communication Culture: Join a team where your ideas are heard, and open dialogue is encouraged, fostering a supportive and transparent work environment
  • Get Things Done Attitude: Be part of a results-driven team that values efficiency, creativity, and the drive to make a tangible impact in the industry

1GLOBAL is an equal opportunity employer, we value your character as much as your talent. Diversity drives our innovation, and we offer a collaborative, dynamic, and international work environment. We are excited for you to join our mission to revolutionise connectivity globally.

    • Elaborar fichas técnicas detalhadas com todas as especificações do produto (materiais, cores, tamanhos, acabamentos, técnicas de costura, etc.).
    • Avaliar e selecionar materiais adequados para cada tipo de produto, garantindo qualidade e adequação à funcionalidade do design.
  2. Processo de Produção
    • Definir os processos produtivos necessários para fabricar os produtos conforme os requisitos de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos.
    • Ajustar padrões de produção, como cortes, modelagem e costura, para garantir que o produto final atenda às especificações.
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção, identificar possíveis problemas técnicos e sugerir soluções para otimizar o processo.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Realizar inspeções durante e após a produção para verificar se os produtos atendem aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
    • Coordenar ou realizar testes de durabilidade, resistência, lavagem e outros parâmetros técnicos para assegurar a conformidade do produto final.
    • Identificar e tratar desvios de qualidade, propondo melhorias ou ajustes nos processos produtivos ou de design.
  4. Ajustes e Melhorias Contínuas
    • Coletar feedback de clientes, áreas de vendas e outras partes envolvidas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos.
    • Propor melhorias no processo de produção visando reduzir custos, melhorar a eficiência e garantir a qualidade.
    • Acompanhar inovações tecnológicas no setor têxtil e sugerir a implementação de novas técnicas ou equipamentos que melhorem o produto ou o processo produtivo.
  5. Gestão de Documentação Técnica
    • Atualizar constantemente as fichas técnicas, garantindo que as informações estejam corretas e acessíveis para as equipes de produção e comercialização.
    • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre o andamento do desenvolvimento de produtos, incluindo testes, qualidade e melhorias implementadas.
  6. Interação com Outras Áreas
    • Colaborar estreitamente com equipes de design e estilistas para garantir que as ideias criativas sejam viáveis do ponto de vista técnico e de produção.
    • Fornecer suporte técnico para a equipe comercial, ajudando a explicar os diferenciais e especificações dos produtos aos clientes ou consumidores.
    • Treinar os operadores de produção, modelistas e outros profissionais envolvidos na fabricação sobre os processos e padrões exigidos.
  7. Sustentabilidade e Conformidade
    • Trabalhar para implementar práticas de produção mais sustentáveis, selecionando materiais ecológicos e otimizando processos para reduzir desperdícios.
    • Garantir que os produtos atendam às normas de segurança, regulamentos ambientais e padrões internacionais de qualidade.

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia têxtil;

Experiência em varejo de moda, com foco em tecido plano.

We are looking for a Content Manager with strong SEO skills to contribute to the success of our top performing betting websites on the Brazilian market. The role is based in Brazil with offices in Rio de Janeiro and São Paulo.

With our talented employees at the forefront we want to conquer the sports media world and become the leading digital sports media group. We want to bring a unique lens to the world of sports, mixing premium content, proprietary tools, and in-depth analysis to make sports fans with something at stake, smarter about betting. Qual será o seu papel nesse propósito?
Como uma pessoa Gerente da área de Consultoria Contábil Financeira (FAAS) você apoiará na determinação, no monitoramento e divulgação de informações financeiras e não financeiras para os stakeholders. Atuando junto às equipes financeiras para que as empresas sigam em conformidade na evolução de seus requisitos financeiros e também que tenham transparência nos relatórios para tomadas de decisão e até mesmo para auditorias que serão realizadas, assumindo as seguintes responsabilidades:

  • Colaborar com o planejamento dos objetivos do trabalho e de uma estratégia de consultoria que esteja em conformidade com as normas profissionais e que aborde o risco de maneira adequada;
  • Entender o segmento em que o cliente atua e reconhecer os principais determinantes de desempenho, tendências dos negócios e desenvolvimentos setoriais e técnicos emergentes;

Estimular a equipe e liderar dando exemplo;
  • Manter-se informado sobre os desenvolvimentos econômicos/corporativos gerais e seu impacto, para manter relacionamentos produtivos com o cliente ao longo do ano;

Crescer, com um entendimento da EY e suas linhas de serviço e fazendo a avaliação/apresentação ativa de formas de aplicar esse conhecimento e os serviços. Desenvolver relacionamentos de longo prazo tanto dentro quanto fora da empresa.

title: Email Marketing Associate
description:
Join to apply for the Email Marketing Associate role at Darkroom .

About Darkroom

Darkroom is a technology-driven growth marketing firm focused on growth-stage consumer companies. Founded in 2017 out of a conviction that iconic ad agencies of tomorrow would look very different, Darkroom is a human services firm built on a universal AI commerce layer called Matter. Our model deploys a unique blend of senior, human resources enriched by an agentic technology stack that enhances output, efficiency, and revenue generation for our clients.

Our team has been responsible for billions of dollars in trackable revenue across various e-commerce marketplace, direct-to-consumer, and social commerce programs under management. Using research aggregated across these engagements, we accelerate results for our portfolio by developing high-impact digital strategies that unlock gateways to revenue growth, transform marketing operations, and prioritize profitability.

What started as a boutique design agency evolved into one of the fastest-growing private companies in America (Inc. 5000), one of the most successful results‑driven performance media agencies of the 2020s (Varos), and earned esteemed recognition by Forbes 30 Under 30 for our founders’ contribution in Marketing & Advertising (Forbes).

About the Role

We are hiring an Email Marketing Specialist – a sharp, creative thinker with a passion for storytelling, conversion, and customer retention. This is not a plug‑and‑play execution role; it requires a high level of ownership, creative problem‑solving, and a strong grasp of lifecycle marketing strategy. You’ll partner closely with Retention Managers and designers to develop and deploy high‑performing email and SMS campaigns for some of the fastest‑growing DTC brands in the world. From ideation and copywriting to QA and reporting, you'll be hands‑on throughout the lifecycle, translating insights into messages that drive revenue, deepen loyalty, and elevate the customer experience.

Darkroom is a career accelerator for marketers who want to operate at the intersection of creativity, commerce, and performance while mastering the tools and tactics of modern CRM strategy.

Fully remote role supporting a team in the EST time zone and open to candidates based in Brazil, Portugal, Spain, Argentina, Colombia and Mexico.

A Day in the Life

  • Work directly with a Retention Marketing Manager to execute data‑driven email and SMS strategies for our DTC/e‑commerce clients.
  • On a daily basis, you will execute tasks for clients including writing, proofing, and scheduling email and SMS campaigns.
  • You’ll work directly with clients to manage the revision and approval process of their emails and SMS messages.
  • On a monthly basis, you’ll develop creative campaign concepts for your client's retention marketing calendars.
  • You’ll work directly with our in‑house design team to develop the design approach, ensuring the design vision for campaigns and flows comes to life, and managing the revision and approval process for client emails.
  • You’ll produce the copy for your campaign concepts and work directly with the client to gain approval on briefs before sending them to our in‑house designers.
  • Driven and enjoy coming to the team and clients with new retention marketing ideas.
  • Execute automation/flow logic set‑up, pop-up builds, and app integrations.

Who You Are

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to join our team! In this role, you will write email and SMS marketing copy, build and deploy email and SMS flows and campaigns, and develop content for our e‑commerce, DTC clients.

  • You’re passionate about developing creative email and SMS marketing copy that drives loyalty and lifetime value for e‑commerce clients.
  • You have experience working in Klaviyo or a similar ESP.
  • You’re passionate about marketing, and especially interested in learning and growing in the DTC and e‑commerce marketing industry.
  • You’re a creative and experienced writer and looking to grow your career in marketing copywriting.
  • You're used to working in a fast‑paced environment and can project manage multiple tasks at once for yourself, your team and your clients.
  • You dedicate time to learning and being on the cutting edge of trends and best practices in the world of DTC marketing.

You Should Apply If This Sounds Like You

  • 2‑4 years of work experience in digital marketing, copywriting, growth marketing, e‑commerce, etc.
  • Past experience working at an agency or working with multiple clients in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Experience working with Klaviyo or similar email service providers.
  • Enthusiastic, passionate, and creative; thrives on thinking outside the box to create new best‑in‑class customer experiences.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication and presentation skills, plus the ability to clearly articulate and express complex and sometimes technical ideas to a wide variety of people and groups at any level.

Working at Darkroom

Darkroom is not a typical agency. We are looking for A players that want to build something great. There is no room in our organization for mediocrity and candidates that are not at the top of their game do not last. We move fast, think deeply, and expect every team member to bring insight and rigor to everything they touch. We hold a high bar for performance, creativity, and ownership — but we also support each other relentlessly. No egos, no red tape — just world‑class talent building something remarkable.

We believe in autonomy with accountability , truth over comfort , and outcomes over optics . If you want to build and win alongside some of the smartest people in the business, you’ll thrive here.

  • Remote‑first culture with a strong community base. With hubs in the Bay Area, New York, Philly, Lisbon, São Paulo, and Barcelona!
  • Parental Leave: flexible parental leave benefits to support new parents during this important transition, ensuring time to bond with their families while maintaining work‑life balance.
  • Endless opportunities for growth: Our agency is founded on an interdisciplinary approach, giving Darkroomers insights into services far beyond your job description. Grow your skills and interests beyond your niche and stay at the forefront of the industry through total immersion in cross‑functional collaboration.

Equal Opportunity Statement

Darkroom is an equal opportunity workplace—we are dedicated to equal employment opportunities regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national orientation, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements.

  • Análise de Dados: Analisar dados de vendas e desempenho para identificar tendências e oportunidades de melhoria para o desenvolvimento da região.

  • Reuniões Regulares: Realizar reuniões regulares de trabalho e resultados com os distribuidores, alinhando expectativas e elaborando planos de ação.
  • Influência Estratégica: Influenciar a estruturação do negócio do distribuidor com base nas diretrizes estratégicas da Tirolez, promovendo melhores práticas e eficiência operacional.

O Analista Tributário Pleno é um profissional essencial para garantir a conformidade fiscal e a eficiência nos processos tributários da organização.   • Análise e conciliação das informações relacionadas às operações da empresa, identificando riscos fiscais e propondo soluções para mitigá-los.
  • Participação ativa no planejamento tributário, consolidando dados e informações para suporte à tomada de decisão.
  • Atualização constante sobre mudanças na legislação tributária, garantindo que a empresa esteja sempre em conformidade com as normas vigentes.

Formação

Bacharel em Ciências Contábeis / Administração / Direito. Cursos e conhecimentos específicos: Desejável Inglês – Intermediário/Avançado.

Valorizamos a diversidade e vemos as diferenças como oportunidades ao invés de barreiras, assegurando condições de pleno desenvolvimento dos nossos profissionais e, também, para a sociedade. Todas as nossas vagas são elegíveis para pessoas com deficiência e/ou reabilitadas.

description:
Join to apply for the ENFERMEIRO EDUCACAO PERMANENTE - HOSPITAL MUNICIPAL PEDRO II role at SPDM/PAIS - Programa de Atenção Integral à Saúde

Desde dezembro de 2015, a SPDM/PAIS é responsável, em parceria com a Secretaria Municipal de Saúde do Rio de Janeiro, pelo gerenciamento do Hospital Municipal Pedro II .

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Exames de imagem (raio X, tomografia, ultrassonografia, eletrocardiografia, ecocardiografia) e laboratoriais também são realizados na unidade.

Devido à grande população de idosos da Zona Oeste, região assistida pelo Hospital Municipal Pedro II (HMPII), há duas Enfermarias destinadas ao atendimento desse público.

O Centro de Tratamento de Queimados é outro diferencial entre os serviços oferecidos, e que dispõe de uma UTI exclusiva para prevenir infecções, que podem ser muito graves para quem está com queimaduras.

Além disso, a unidade conta com a Coordenação de Emergência Regional (CER) Santa Cruz, que possui 39 leitos, e tem como objetivo absorver as demandas de menor complexidade, deixando o HMPII liberado para os casos de risco iminente de morte, necessidade de cirurgia urgente e/ou internação. Um diferencial deste CER é o fato de possuir atendimento especializado em Psiquiatria e Obstetrícia.

Responsabilidades e atribuições

Elaborar e implantar programas de desenvolvimento e capacitação dos empregados, com o propósito de auxiliar os mesmos no atingimento das metas e objetivos estabelecidos pela Instituição.

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Ensino Superior Completo em Enfermagem.
  • Registro Ativo no Conselho da Classe.
  • Pós-Graduação Completa na área de educação.
  • Experiência mínima de 6 meses na função de Enfermeiro em Educação Permanente.

Informações adicionais

Local de Trabalho: Santa Cruz - Rio de Janeiro

Escala 40 horas semanais - de Segunda a Sexta-feira

Horário: 08:00 às 17:00

Profissionais de empresas parceiras, fornecedores e/ou prestadores de serviços, vínculo com grau de parentesco ou afinidade no mesmo serviço ou que atuam em outra modalidade contratual (vínculo com o prestador), deverão observar normativas de RH vigentes, através de consulta junto ao setor de Recrutamento e Seleção.

description:
Field Compliance Coordinator - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Position : Field Compliance Coordinator with full relocation to Saudi Arabia as a permanent full‑time expatriate. Attractive relocation package. Qualified candidates will be contacted.

Position Description

We are seeking a Field Compliance Coordinator to join our Upstream OE & Compliance Division. The Division is responsible for providing safety support to Upstream Executive Management and various organizations through HSE reporting, safety audits, recommendations, human‑factor guidance, training, major incident investigations, and lessons‑learned creation. Your primary role will support upstream organizations on Process Safety and major incident investigations for onshore and offshore drilling and oil & gas processing plants.

Key Responsibilities

  • Enhance safety standards and procedures such as work permits, process safety, hazard identification, risk management, and emergency preparedness.
  • Develop loss‑prevention, fire‑prevention, and safety standards, procedures, and General Instructions (GIs) for matters not covered by existing resources.
  • Consult with upstream management to facilitate Safety Management System (SMS) enhancement.
  • Create critical safety documents for major activities such as job safety analyses and hazard identification plans.
  • Assist departments in preparing for major safety reviews, including loss‑prevention compliance reviews.
  • Research emerging safety technologies and conduct feasibility studies and cost analyses to identify improved solutions for existing safety problems and regulatory requirements.
  • Act as a process‑safety audit expert during design, construction, commissioning, turnover to operations, ongoing operations, change management, and decommissioning.
  • Develop and deliver safety training material and safe‑work procedures to field personnel.
  • Instruct on safety concepts, practices, and standards (both on‑the‑job and classroom).
  • Direct and participate in preparing major reference manuals documenting corporate and LP safety systems, policies, and procedures (e.g., LP Policy, SMS manual, Safety Handbook, Construction Safety Manual).
  • Facilitate and lead incident investigations, including interviewing witnesses, gathering data, and conducting root‑cause analysis.
  • Facilitate and lead safety audits by identifying non‑compliance with occupational health and safety regulations and advising on improvements.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, HSE, or an equivalent accredited program.
  • Minimum of 10 years of experience in upstream organizations spanning exploration, drilling, and production on both onshore and offshore sites, with at least 5 years in a senior loss‑prevention or fire‑prevention role.
  • Strong technical expertise in process safety disciplines such as design engineering, loss control management, hazard identification, HAZOP reviews, incident investigations, emergency preparedness, response, and safety management systems.
  • Experience with HAZOP and SIL studies is preferred; internationally recognized certifications are advantageous.

Working Environment

Our high‑performing employees are drawn by challenging and rewarding professional, technical, and industrial opportunities, and are remunerated accordingly.

Benefits

Permanent expatriate relocation package, competitive compensation, and opportunities for career development within a global energy leader.

title: Analista de Suporte N2 – Redes
description:
Sobre a empresa

Somos um provedor de internet em crescimento, focado em qualidade, estabilidade e atendimento próximo aos nossos clientes.
Buscamos um Analista N2 Pleno para cuidar da parte técnica da rede e apoiar a expansão da empresa.

Missão do cargo

Garantir que a rede funcione de forma estável , resolvendo problemas técnicos de clientes e da infraestrutura, atuando entre o atendimento N1 e a engenharia/N3 .

Atividades principais

  • Atender chamados escalados pelo N1 (casos que o N1 não conseguiu resolver).
  • Analisar conectividade :
    • Testes de ping e traceroute (IP e domínio).
    • Identificar se o problema está no cliente, na rede interna, no POP, na rota ou na operadora.
  • Acessar e analisar OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia ou similar):
    • Ver potência RX/TX das ONUs.
    • Ver ONUs flutuando (online/offline).
    • Verificar erros e utilização das portas GPON.
  • Verificar e ajustar VLAN, PPPoE, IPoE e DHCP :
    • Sessões PPPoE travadas.
    • Cliente autenticando e não navegando.
    • Cliente sem IP ou recebendo IP incorreto.
  • Apoiar o time de campo com diagnóstico técnico (indicar provável ponto de falha).
  • Utilizar ferramentas de monitoramento (Zabbix, Grafana ou similares) para identificar e prevenir instabilidades.
  • Registrar nos chamados o passo a passo do diagnóstico e da solução .

Requisitos técnicos (obrigatórios)

  • Experiência prévia em provedor de internet ou suporte de redes .
  • Bom conhecimento de TCP/IP (IP, máscara, gateway, DNS, rota).
  • Entender bem PPPoE e/ou IPoE .
  • Saber trabalhar com VLAN (ACCESS/TRUNK, tagged/untagged).
  • Noções sólidas de IPv4 e NAT.
  • Uso prático de ping , tracert/traceroute e testes por IP e domínio.
  • Conhecimento básico em ao menos um equipamento de borda, por exemplo: Mikrotik, Cisco, Huawei ou similar .
  • Capacidade de leitura e interpretação de logs (roteador, OLT, servidor PPPoE/DHCP).

Diferenciais (não obrigatórios, mas contam ponto)

  • Experiência com OLT GPON (ZTE, Huawei, Fiberhome, Nokia, etc.).
  • Conhecimento de CGNAT / BNG / BRAS .
  • Experiência com Zabbix, Grafana ou outras ferramentas de monitoramento.
  • Noções de IPv6 .
  • Cursos ou certificações em redes (MTCNA, CCNA , etc.).
  • Já trabalhou em provedor de internet.
  • Sabe mexer em OLT GPON na prática (ver potência, ONU, porta, erros).
  • Usa Mikrotik ou similar no dia a dia.
  • Consegue resolver a maioria dos problemas sem supervisão.
  • Já trabalhou com redes/provedor.
  • Conhece TCP/IP, PPPoE, VLAN.
  • Atua com OLT GPON + Mikrotik + monitoramento (Zabbix/Grafana) .
  • Entende bem PPPoE, IPoE, VLAN, NAT, CGNAT/BNG .
  • Consegue segurar plantão e dar suporte ao time como referência técnica.

Perfil comportamental

  • Gosta de resolver problema até o fim , sem “empurrar para o outro”.
  • Sabe trabalhar sob pressão, mantendo calma e foco.Boa comunicação com N1, N3 e técnicos de campo .
  • Organização para registrar tudo o que faz.
  • Vontade de aprender e crescer junto com a empresa .

Jornada / Modelo

  • Regime: CLT – 44h semanais
  • Horário: segunda a sexta, das 09h às 17h
  • Sábado, das 09h às 13h
  • Local: Av Ayrton Senna 3000, Edíficio Itanhanga (Via Parque) – Presencial

title: ENGENHEIRO TÉCNICO DE PRODUTO FOCO EM BIQUINI
description:
Estamos com uma posição para Engenheiro técnico de produto com foco em biquíni. Suas atividades estarão voltadas para o desenvolvimento, melhoria e controle de qualidade de produtos têxteis, atuando em diversas etapas do processo de criação e fabricação, garantindo que os produtos atendam aos requisitos técnicos e de mercado.

Atribuições e responsabilidades:

  1. Análise e Desenvolvimento de Produto
    • Desenvolver protótipos de novos produtos, considerando o design, materiais, funcionalidades e estética.
    • Elaborar fichas técnicas detalhadas com todas as especificações do produto (materiais, cores, tamanhos, acabamentos, técnicas de costura, etc.).
    • Avaliar e selecionar materiais adequados para cada tipo de produto, garantindo qualidade e adequação à funcionalidade do design.
  2. Processo de Produção
    • Definir os processos produtivos necessários para fabricar os produtos conforme os requisitos de qualidade e prazos estabelecidos.
    • Ajustar padrões de produção, como cortes, modelagem e costura, para garantir que o produto final atenda às especificações.
    • Monitorar o andamento da produção, identificar possíveis problemas técnicos e sugerir soluções para otimizar o processo.
  3. Controle de Qualidade
    • Realizar inspeções durante e após a produção para verificar se os produtos atendem aos padrões de qualidade estabelecidos.
    • Coordenar ou realizar testes de durabilidade, resistência, lavagem e outros parâmetros técnicos para assegurar a conformidade do produto final.
    • Identificar e tratar desvios de qualidade, propondo melhorias ou ajustes nos processos produtivos ou de design.
  4. Ajustes e Melhorias Contínuas
    • Coletar feedback de clientes, áreas de vendas e outras partes envolvidas para identificar oportunidades de melhoria nos produtos.
    • Propor melhorias no processo de produção visando reduzir custos, melhorar a eficiência e garantir a qualidade.
    • Acompanhar inovações tecnológicas no setor têxtil e sugerir a implementação de novas técnicas ou equipamentos que melhorem o produto ou o processo produtivo.
  5. Gestão de Documentação Técnica
    • Atualizar constantemente as fichas técnicas, garantindo que as informações estejam corretas e acessíveis para as equipes de produção e comercialização.
    • Elaborar relatórios técnicos sobre o andamento do desenvolvimento de produtos, incluindo testes, qualidade e melhorias implementadas.
  6. Interação com Outras Áreas
    • Colaborar estreitamente com equipes de design e estilistas para garantir que as ideias criativas sejam viáveis do ponto de vista técnico e de produção.
    • Fornecer suporte técnico para a equipe comercial, ajudando a explicar os diferenciais e especificações dos produtos aos clientes ou consumidores.
    • Treinar os operadores de produção, modelistas e outros profissionais envolvidos na fabricação sobre os processos e padrões exigidos.
  7. Sustentabilidade e Conformidade
    • Trabalhar para implementar práticas de produção mais sustentáveis, selecionando materiais ecológicos e otimizando processos para reduzir desperdícios.
    • Garantir que os produtos atendam às normas de segurança, regulamentos ambientais e padrões internacionais de qualidade.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Ensino superior completo em Engenharia têxtil;

Experiência em varejo de moda, com foco em biquíni.

The role of a Technical Author
A Technical Author leads the documentation efforts of an engineering team, typically focused on a product or family of products. You'll help the team develop documentation that serves the needs of the product's users, embracing the principles of the Diátaxis documentation framework. You will have a broad impact on - and responsibility for - the quality of the user experience with the product, and will contribute towards the long-term success of the project itself.
These are not traditional technical writer roles. As a Technical Author, you will participate in development of product strategy. You will have input into product design and user experience. You will combine technical expertise with leadership in documentation, collaborating with colleagues across the company to establish documentation as a first-class engineering discipline. Even the most junior Technical Authors will have the opportunity to develop and demonstrate technical authority.
As well as your role in an engineering team, you will also be a part of Canonical's documentation practice team, that includes all the company's Technical Authors. Here, you'll be amongst other documentation experts, who collaborate to define documentation excellence and drive the development of documentation practice and theory, across the company and in the open-source software community.
Location: These are fully remote roles, open to candidates across the globe.

The Company You’ll Join

Carta is a platform that helps people manage equity, build businesses, and invest in the companies of tomorrow. Our mission is to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places.

Carta's tender offer solutions have returned $14B to shareholders in secondary transactions. Today, Carta’s platform manages nearly three trillion dollars in equity globally.

For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You’ll Solve

At Carta, our employees set out on a mission to unlock the power of equity ownership for more people in more places. We believe that the problems we solve today unlock the opportunities of tomorrow.

As an Implementations Accountant, you will focus efforts on supporting new Fund Administration customers in their journey into Carta services. You work within our fast-growing Fund Administration business by coordinating, facilitating and managing onboarding activities that are critical to achieving success for both our customers and Carta within a tight deadline. You will:

  • Liaise between Sales and Fund Accounting teams as the bridge post-sales for new fund clients
  • Interact with a fund’s back office (CFO, fund manager) to collect their historical accounting data, provide advisory support, and ultimately deliver accurate financial statements to both the client and internal stakeholders
  • Book and reconcile all accounting books and records from, at times, unstructured client data. This includes reproducing Capital Calls, Distributions, Expenses, Investments, Management Fees, Financial Statements, and Partners’ Capital to match client sources.
  • Resolving escalations related to data migration, historical accounting discrepancies, and client onboarding issues
  • Manage all aspects of customer onboarding for medium to high complexity new clients by managing timelines, setting clear customer expectations, and completing all compliance procedures pre go-live
  • Build strong client relationships and provide a white glove experience by going on-site, anticipating client needs, and using Carta app capabilities effectively
  • Identify process and quality improvements, assist with internal reviews, Quality Assurance, and train junior team members

description:
Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica - Rede Hospital Casa - CLT

Somos a Rede Hospital Casa, um dos maiores operadores médicos hospitalares independentes do estado do Rio de Janeiro. O ACOLHIMENTO COMO NOSSO JEITO DE CUIDAR está entre os nossos principais valores.

Estamos em busca de um profissional para atuar como Técnico de Imobilização Ortopédica que seja proativo, cuidadoso, dedicado e que tenha atenção e amor com seus processos de trabalho.

Suas principais atividades serão:

  • Assumir o posto de serviço conforme escala, devidamente identificado, uniformizado e com aparência pessoal adequada;
  • Identificar corretamente o paciente antes de realizar o procedimento;
  • Preparar paciente para procedimentos de imobilização ortopédica;
  • Preparar material para confeccionar as imobilizações;
  • Preparar sala para pequenos procedimentos fora do centro cirúrgico, como pequenas suturas e anestesia local para manobras de redução manual, punções e infiltrações;
  • Observar o tipo de imobilização a confeccionar, as condições do paciente, seguindo orientações e prescrição médica;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações e aparelhos gessados nas salas de gesso e cirurgia;
  • Confeccionar imobilizações com material sintético, aparelhos gessados, goteiras gessadas, esparadrapagem, talas digitais (imobilização para os dedos), enfaixamento, tração cutânea, colar cervical, entre outros, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Retirar aparelhos de imobilização ortopédica, conforme prescrição médica;
  • Utilizar de forma adequada equipamentos como serra elétrica vibratória;
  • Realizar procedimentos específicos em imobilizações ortopédicas, como a abertura de janelas no aparelho gessado;
  • Manter sala de imobilização organizada;
  • Zelar pela limpeza da sala, bem como organização e preservação e guarda de materiais e equipamentos de uso na sua especialidade;
  • Auxiliar o médico ortopedista em procedimentos ortopédicos não cirúrgicos, como na instalação de trações esqueléticas e manobras de redução manual;
  • Realizar lançamento e registro em prontuário dos procedimentos realizados e materiais utilizados;
  • Promover orientações pertinentes e de conservação da imobilização aos pacientes;
  • Auxiliar a equipe multidisciplinar em imobilizações de pacientes vítimas de trauma ou que necessitem de restrição total de movimento;
  • Obedecer às normas técnicas da Sociedade Brasileira de Ortopedia e Traumatologia (SBOT), às normas internacionais para confecção de imobilização, normas regulamentadoras de Segurança do Trabalho e o Código de Ética Profissional;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda e qualquer ocorrência administrativa;
  • Notificar a equipe de enfermagem toda ocorrência durante atendimento ao paciente;
  • Participar de treinamentos institucional e setorial quando solicitado sua participação;
  • Cumprir as normas e regulamentos da Instituição, bem como as rotinas operacionais da sua Unidade;
  • Respeitar e conhecer os instrumentos normativos do setor como instruções de trabalho.

Esperamos que você tenha:

Card Authority and Disputes Administrator

Join to apply for the Card Authority and Disputes Administrator role at Paymentology .

At Paymentology , we’re redefining what’s possible in the payments space. As the first truly global issuer‑processor, we give banks and fintechs the technology and talent to launch and manage Mastercard and Visa cards at scale across more than 60 countries. Our advanced, multi‑cloud platform delivers real‑time data, unmatched scalability, and the flexibility of shared or dedicated processing instances. It's this global reach and innovation that sets us apart.

We’re looking for a Card Authority and Disputes Administrator to manage and process chargebacks, transaction disputes, and card authority operations across global card networks. This role ensures every case and authorisation exception is validated, documented, and resolved in line with regulatory and card scheme standards. You’ll play a key role in protecting clients and cardholders from financial loss while upholding Paymentology’s operational integrity, operating independently on assigned cases and prioritising workload against SLA and regulatory deadlines.

Responsibilities

  • Handle and process cardholder disputes involving authorised and unauthorised transactions.
  • Conduct detailed investigations using multiple internal systems and external partners.
  • Validate data accuracy and ensure all documentation meets compliance and network standards.
  • Determine appropriate actions and craft timely, accurate responses to networks within SLA and regulatory timelines.
  • Oversee card authority processes including transaction approvals, declines, and authorisation reviews.
  • Provide guidance to internal teams and clients on dispute outcomes, escalations, and card authorisation queries.
  • Maintain current knowledge of card scheme rules, dispute categories, and operational procedures.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives in dispute resolution, authorisation processes, and reporting accuracy.

Requirements

  • Strong understanding of Visa/Mastercard dispute and card authorisation processes and compliance standards.
  • Skilled in Microsoft Office Suite (Excel, Outlook, Word) and case management tools.
  • Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.
  • Analytical, customer‑centric, and detail‑oriented, with the ability to work to tight deadlines.
  • Able to coordinate with card network partners, client operations teams, and internal reconciliation staff to ensure compliance and customer satisfaction.
  • 2–4 years in dispute resolution, card operations, or financial customer service.

What You Can Look Forward To

At Paymentology , it’s not just about building great payment technology, it’s about building a company where people feel they belong and their work matters. You’ll be part of a diverse, global team that’s genuinely committed to making a positive impact through what we do. Whether you’re working across time zones or getting involved in initiatives that support local communities, you’ll find real purpose in your work and the freedom to grow in a supportive, forward‑thinking environment.

description:
Overview

The position is for the Senior Manager, Telecom at FIFA Women’s World Cup . FIFA27 will be established as the Local FIFA Subsidiary in Brazil, to work with FIFA HQ in Zurich and globally, to deliver the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 (FWWC2027).

Department: Technology

Location: Brazil

Please submit your CV in English, as it will be reviewed by an international team.

The Position

The Senior Telecom Manager is responsible for managing the Telecom Infrastructure planning, delivery, and operations for the FIFA Women’s World Cup 2027 TM (FWWC 2027) within Brazil. The role entails coordinating with all relevant parties on the planning, implementation, readiness and operations of all Telecom services pertinent to the tournament and/or associated events within Brazil.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review Telecom Infrastructure design and ensure all aspects of the Telecom deliverables are implemented at venues and offices according to FIFA requirements: Broadcast Contribution Network, Event/Stadium/Offices/Legacy Networks, CATV/IPTV, Cabling, Mobile Network, Radio and Spectrum, Telephony (VoIP), Telecom Rate Card.
  • Actively participate in the scope definition, procurement liaison, supplier selection and onboarding of Telecom and Network suppliers
  • Lead the management of Telecom infrastructure build and implementation, ensuring timely availability of components and services and including the commissioning and decommissioning of venues.
  • Overseeing the effective and efficient provision of Telecom services for FIFA Offices, Tournaments and Events at select FIFA Events.
  • Track the progress of Telecom Infrastructure implementation, report status, issues and risks related to Telecom Infrastructure projects and operations, according to IT governance and keep counterpart aligned.
  • Manage an international Team of Telecom Experts/Managers including remote personnel in other countries/time zones.
  • Liaise with and/or support other projects in clarifying requirements, adhering to robust change management protocol.
  • Ensure that all information pertaining to the delivery and support of Telecom Infrastructure are communicated to and well understood by all parties.
  • Deliver technical guidance, coaching & mentoring to team members, including preparation of good practice and educational material for personnel.

Your Profile

  • University degree or similar higher education in Information Technology, Computer Science or related field
  • A minimum experience of 8-10 years in Network (routing/switching/security/wireless technologies)
  • Experience in the Sports / major event industry
  • Proven track record of successful delivery of complex Telecom Infrastructure Projects
  • Experience in Management of distributed international team of telecom experts and professionals
  • Strong IT skills and relevant knowledge in Telecom Infrastructure Service, including infrastructure design and implementation, network integration and connectivity.
  • Broad understanding of Telecom Infrastructure and Information Technologies in Sport Events with sufficient experience in design, commissioning and operation of BCN, WAN/MAN/LAN, MPLS, VLAN, VoIP, CATV/IPTV, Multicast, Spectrum, Mobile Networks
  • Good Procurement and contract management skills
  • Aptitude for consulting, negotiating, communicating, consensus building and facilitation
  • Good analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent people management, verbal and written communication, training, and presentation skills
  • Team player, willing to work with tight timelines
  • Positive attitude, patience and persistence
  • Right to work in Brazil
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • Fluent in Portuguese (spoken and written)
  • Proficiency in any other FIFA language (FR/ ES/ GER) is an asset
  • Willing to travel within Brazil (up to 20%), with some trips lasting 15 days or more
  • Ability to relocate to Rio de Janeiro

Seniority level

  • Mid-Senior level

  • Suporte ao coordenador de GEP durante toda a execução e passagem de serviço do poço;
  • Participação nas reuniões do poço projetado (como análises de risco e gestão de mudança);
  • Elaboração de análise preliminar de riscos, conforme padrões e normas;
  • Avaliação de sondas quanto otimização a segurança operacional contemplando, mas não limitado aos seguintes itens (Capacidade de corte do BOP, disponibilidade de EDS’s, avaliação do sistema de compensação e de posicionamento dinâmico da unidade e dos obstáculos na locação);
  • Elaboração de gestões de mudança de projeto;
  • Suportar a elaboração do documento de passagem de serviço dos poços (Handover);

Requisitos e Qualificações

  • Formação: Curso de Nível Superior em Engenharia em instituição reconhecida pelo Ministério da Educação (MEC) ou outro órgão do governo federal destinado a esse fim, com registro no respectivo Conselho de Classe.

  • Conhecimentos Técnicos: Competência de Dados — tratamento, transferência, coleta, organização, agrupamento, noções de análise estatística, árvore de decisão; Pacote Office: Word, Excel, Power Point; Power BI: Noções, filtros, organização dos dados, pesquisa. Operação básica com dados; Noções de projeto de poço marítimo; Noções de construção de poço direcional, vertical e horizontal como operador e como projetista: premissas básicas de projetos, limitações e boas práticas em projetos e execução; Noções de equipamentos de sondas de perfuração; Noções de conceitos básicos de perfuração direcional; Conhecimento de ferramentas direcionais: motores de fundo, rotary steerable e turbinas de perfuração (seleção, limites operacionais, vantagens e desvantagens e operação); Noções de ferramentas de mapeamento de poço: MWD, GWD, Gyro; Noções de ferramentas de perfilagem: LWD e ferramentas a cabo. Limites e operação (poço aberto e poço revestido); Influência do direcional nas descidas a cabo por gravidade; Noções de projeto de BHA: tubulares, alargadores, escareadores, percussores de perfuração; Noções de operação e projeto utilizando sistemas de alargamento (alargadores, ferramentas de eliminação de offset broca x alargador em manobra única, estabilização no poço alargado etc.); Noções de simulação: torque e drag, hidráulica de poço e desgaste de revestimento; Noções de brocas de perfuração: seleção e cálculo de hidráulica; Noções de hidráulica de poço: correlação entre limpeza de poço e geometria de trajetória; Noções de segurança de poço e análise anticolisão entre poços; Noções de geologia e geodésia; Noções de orçamentação de poços; Noções de operação e projeto de testemunhagem; Noções de operações e projeto de canhoneio; Noções de operações e projeto de MPD; Noções básicas dos tipos de completação (contenção de areia, completações simples e inteligentes, etc.); Noções básicas sobre cimentação, recimentação e correção da cimentação; Aplicação do canhoneio nos diferentes tipos de completação (cargas e densidades); Noções básicas de workover e de abandono; Noções básicas de caracterização de reservatório (geologia, geofísica e avaliação de reservatórios); Idiomas: Português (Brasil) - escrita e oral – nível fluente; Inglês técnico - escrita e oral - nível intermediário; Possuir noções básicas de construção de poços marítimos e dos equipamentos e sistemas de unidades de perfuração marítima; Desejáveis noções básicas em brocas, perfuração direcional, MPD, integridade de poços, estabilidade geomecânica de poços, fundações de poços, fluidos de perfuração, cimentação e equipamentos que compõem a estrutura de poços (cabeça de poço, revestimentos etc).
