Pay Competitive

Employment type Other

Job Description

    Req#: 19863

    Local Unit & Position Description

    • Lead the on the ground, customer facing activities within LATAM, become that go to person for our clients.
    • Attend client meetings, conferences and lobby stakeholders as required to get the job done.
    • The main contributor to the development of the strategic business development plan identifying key clients, stakeholders and markets and execute.
    • Increase the exposure and market knowledge of DNV Digital Solutions products from the Renewable and Ocean Structures product portfolio to the LATAM markets, especially in the offshore wind sector.
    • Implement cross DNV BA sales strategies to provide a compelling value proposition to our client.
    • Own the end-to-end sales process and the associated sales target.
    • Identify unmanaged strategic Key Accounts and actively manage these accounts during the early stages of their engagement with DNV Digital Solutions to build a solid relationship across the clients organization, at decision maker, influencer and user levels.
    • Develop long standing, resilient client relationships which lead to a win-win scenario for both them and DNV.
    • Mentor members of the BD team with lesser experience.
    • Be an integral part of the wider Americas Region commercial team – this is not a role for a lone wolf.

    Position Qualifications

    Required;

    • 10 years Industry experience in Business Development with demonstratable track record in expanding the product market penetration, achieving / surpassing realistic sales targets.
    • Minimum Bachelors degree in engineering or business
    • Be the tenacious hunter.
    • Extrovert, happy to present to both small client groups but also to large audiences.
    • Proactively build and maintain strong relationships, both externally and internally.
    • Have worked in a multi-cultural commercial environment.
    • Courage to make qualified independent decisions and move forward.
    • Solution oriented and highly proactive.
    • Collaborative, both within immediate team and the wider business.
    • Excellent communication skills and ability to inspire people, building strong relationships.
    • Ability to travel to where the customer is – primarily within LATAM.
    • Fluent in English & Portuguese, both spoken and written.

    Preferable;

    • Experience in Renewables and/or offshore energy industries within the LATAM market.
    • A professional network within the offshore and / or wind sector; this may be from a substructure design / developer / OEM / software domain.
    • Commercial experience within the technical software sector.
    • Fluent in Spanish, both spoken and written.
    • MBA degree

    Company & Business Area Description

    DNV is the independent expert in assurance and risk management, operating in more than 100 countries. Through our broad experience and deep expertise we advance safety and sustainable performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions.

    We are a world-leading provider of digital solutions and software applications with focus on the energy, maritime and healthcare markets. Our solutions are used worldwide to manage risk and performance for wind turbines, electric grids, pipelines, processing plants, offshore structures, ships, and more. Supported by our domain knowledge and Veracity assurance platform, we enable companies to digitize and manage business critical activities in a sustainable, cost-efficient, safe and secure way.

    Product Line Renewables & Ocean Structures builds and distributes engineering software. Our mission is to “empower the world’s professionals to accelerate the energy transition, and sustainable use of the ocean”, and we aim “to be the most trusted engineering and digitalization partner, bringing value through our customer experience focus”. Our portfolio of software products includes a combination of successful industry favorites like Sesam, Bladed, and Nauticus Machinery, and new products aiming for hypergrowth WindFarmer and SolarFarmer.

    Our Product Line is part of the DNV – Digital Solutions business area, built up of functional teams across a collaborative organization structure. The Renewables & Ocean Structures product line includes a product center where software is developed, a product management team, sales regions and a marketing and communications team.

    This Senior Business Development role will report to the Head of Business Development, Americas Region as part of the commercial management team.

    The Senior Business Development Manager will have responsibility for leading DNV’s client facing strategy within the LATAM market, with the key focus on Brazil, to roll out a multi-year roadmap for the expansion of our market footprint within country.

    The key focus of this role is to develop DNV Digital Solutions penetration and market position within the LATAM market, the primary focus of which will be offshore wind. The Senior Business Development Manager will lead by example and build strong relationships, both internally with the wider regional commercial team, along with global functions, including the Product Line & Product Center, MarCom, Legal and Finance as well as interaction with clients at a senior, decision-maker level.

  • Exposure to performance tuning, caching, messaging/queue systems (e.g., Kafka), and feature flag management.

The Company You’ll Join

Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure.

Together, Carta is creating the end‑to‑end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital.

At Carta we create owners and make private markets liquid.

We live in a world where some people live on the equity stack and enjoy exponential wealth growth and preferential tax treatment; others live on the debt stack and may work their entire lives for a company and retire only with the cash they’ve managed to save from their paychecks. Our contribution to solving the wealth inequality problem is moving people from the debt stack (payroll) to the equity stack. By making it as easy to issue equity to employees as it is to put them on payroll, we can create more owners.

At Carta, we are helpful, transparent, fair, and kind. We are relentless executors, unconventional thinkers, and masters of our craft.

At Mindrift, innovation meets opportunity. We believe in using the power of collective human intelligence to ethically shape the future of AI.

What We Do

The Mindrift platform, launched and powered by Toloka, connects domain experts with cutting‑edge AI projects from innovative tech clients. Our mission is to unlock the potential of GenAI by tapping into real-world expertise from across the globe.

Who we’re looking for

We’re looking for curious and intellectually proactive contributors, the kind of person who double‑checks assumptions and plays devil’s advocate. Are you comfortable with ambiguity and complexity? Does an async, remote, flexible opportunity sound exciting? Would you like to learn how modern AI systems are tested and evaluated?

Type of role

This is a flexible, project-based opportunity well‑suited for:

  • Analysts, researchers, or consultants with strong critical‑thinking skills
  • Students (senior undergrads / grad students) looking for an intellectually interesting gig
  • People open to a part‑time and non‑permanent opportunity

About the project

We’re on the hunt for QAs for autonomous AI agents for a new project focused on validating and improving complex task structures, policy logic, and agent evaluation frameworks. Throughout the project, you’ll have to balance quality assurance, research, and logical problem‑solving. This project opportunity is ideal for people who enjoy looking at systems holistically and thinking through scenarios, implications, and edge cases. You do not need a coding background, but you must be curious, intellectually rigorous, and capable of evaluating the soundness and consistency of complex setups.

What you’ll be doing

  • Reviewing evaluation tasks and scenarios for logic, completeness, and realism
  • Identifying inconsistencies, missing assumptions, or unclear decision points
  • Helping define clear expected behaviours (gold standards) for AI agents
  • Annotating cause‑effect relationships, reasoning paths, and plausible alternatives
  • Thinking through complex systems and policies as a human would to ensure agents are tested properly
  • Working closely with QA, writers, or developers to suggest refinements or edge case coverage

How to get started

Apply to this post, qualify, and get the chance to contribute to a project aligned with your skills, on your own schedule. Shape the future of AI while building tools that benefit everyone.

Requirements

  • Excellent analytical thinking: can reason about complex systems, scenarios, and logical implications
  • Strong attention to detail: can spot contradictions, ambiguities, and vague requirements
  • Familiarity with structured data formats: can read, not necessarily write JSON/YAML
  • Ability to assess scenarios holistically: what’s missing, what’s unrealistic, what might break?
  • Good communication and clear writing (in English) to document your findings.

We also value applicants who have

  • Experience with policy evaluation, logic puzzles, case studies, or structured scenario design
  • Background in consulting, academia, olympiads (e.g. logic/math/informatics), or research
  • Exposure to LLMs, prompt engineering, or AI‑generated content
  • Familiarity with QA or test‑case thinking (edge cases, failure modes, “what could go wrong”)
  • Some understanding of how scoring or evaluation works in agent testing (precision, coverage, etc.)

Benefits

  • Get paid for your expertise, with rates that can go up to $17/hour depending on your skills, experience, and project needs
  • Take part in a flexible, remote, freelance project that fits around your primary professional or academic commitments
  • Participate in an advanced AI project and gain valuable experience to enhance your portfolio
  • Influence how future AI models understand and communicate in your field of expertise

Art Lead - NFL Universe Football

Join to apply for the Art Lead - NFL Universe Football role at Voldex.

Voldex is a leading gaming company focused on Roblox, the most exciting ecosystem in gaming today. We are home to several of Roblox’s top games, including Brookhaven, Driving Empire, and NFL Universe Football. With over 145 million monthly active players across our games, we are the #1 Roblox developer by audience size. Founded in 2015, we have since grown to 75+ full‑time remote team members across the globe.

Our top games include:

  • Brookhaven, #1 Roleplay game on Roblox and the most popular game on the Roblox platform
  • Driving Empire, the #1 driving game on Roblox where we’ve brought real cars into the game in partnership with automakers
  • NFL Universe Football, the #1 American football game and top grossing sports game on Roblox

Responsibilities

  • Contribute a consistent allocation of time to building out 3D art assets for the game
  • Address artistic challenges, manage art‑team workloads, and ensure art assets are delivered on time, efficiently, and within the technical performance budget
  • Lead, manage, and mentor a small team of artists, providing clear direction, constructive feedback, and fostering a positive, creative work environment
  • Lead game’s style and art direction
  • Supervise both 2D, 3D, and render artists
  • Develop and maintain art‑production pipelines, processes, and documentation to ensure efficient asset creation and implementation
  • Review and provide feedback on the team’s work, ensuring assets meet quality standards and align with the artistic vision and technical requirements of the project

Requirements

  • A deep understanding of asset performance metrics and methodologies on the Roblox platform
  • High proficiency in Roblox Studio and substantial experience on the Roblox platform
  • 1‑3 years of experience working in a professional studio environment or a mixture of Roblox creator experience that demonstrates equivalent expertise and leadership
  • Highly organized and process oriented, needs to be able to think in scale and systems to help level up the Art team

Nice to Have

  • Experience creating art assets under performance constraints while maintaining a clear, visually appealing style
  • Experience collaborating with game designers and product teams to understand art request details and flag risks or needs for additional information
  • Proven ability to own a game’s art direction and mentor a team of artists toward a consistent execution of that style or direction
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to manage and mentor a diverse team of artists
  • Familiarity with project management tools such as Monday.com, Asana, JIRA, or similar applications
  • Familiar with or a fan of American Football

Tech Stack

  • Roblox Studio
  • Photoshop / GIMP / Substance Painter
  • Maya

Location

  • Remote

  • Medical, dental, and vision benefits – depending on the country, there may be additional benefits (Life, ADD, etc…) such as Canada, UK and USA.

  • In‑person get‑togethers, virtual company‑wide game events, Robux allowances, and so much more!

  • Work with awesome people and impact millions of daily players

Responsabilidade principal da vaga

Demais responsabilidades

Requisitos e qualificações

  • Formação Superior Completa.
  • Experiência com análise e controle de custos, preferencialmente em logística.

  • Conhecimento de SAP e Power BI avançado.

Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia aqui é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Ah, nesse papo também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você consiga nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado!

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, aonde você poderá conhecer um pouco mais sobre os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo!

Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Somos a PRIO, a maior companhia independente de óleo e gás do Brasil. Buscamos continuamente por otimização de processos operacionais e de soluções inovadoras que visem diminuir os custos. Aqui todo trabalho é multidisciplinar e cada desafio é único!

Com foco no investimento e na recuperação de ativos em produção, somos especializados na gestão eficiente de reservatórios e no redesenvolvimento de campos maduros. Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nosso ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões.

Nossa cultura busca o alto desempenho e a participação efetiva de todas as pessoas. Se você sonha em se desenvolver junto com uma empresa em constante crescimento, venha fazer parte do nosso time!

title: Social Investment Senior Advisor
description:
Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil

Job Family Group: Corporate Relations

Worker Type: Regular

Posting Start Date: December 9, 2025

Business Unit: CoS and Corporate Relations

Experience Level: Experienced Professionals

What’s the role

You will be a key player in our Societal Impact and Energy Transition program team in Shell Brasil’s Corporate Relations team. One of our objectives is to create a positive presence and legacy in the communities and countries in which we operate and to be a trusted and responsible neighbour. We do this by engaging with our communities, identifying and mitigating the social impacts of our operations, and delivering benefits through social investment. You will be working closely with the Societal Impact and Energy Transition Program Manager and business colleagues in the country, as well as the regional and global Social Performance Centre of Excellence in Shell.

What you’ll be doing

  • Developing and implementing a robust social investment strategy for Shell in Brazil that is aligned with our business objectives in-country, Shell’s Group social investment strategy and requirements, and the social context of our communities
  • Identifying and designing meaningful social investment programmes in line with the strategy
  • Selecting and managing delivery partners to help us implement our social investment programmes
  • Driving implementation of the social investment programmes, with clear oversight and regular review of performance against goals and targets
  • Developing and executing monitoring, evaluation, and learning plans for our social investment programmes, jointly with our delivery partners
  • Undertaking social baseline and evaluation studies as needed to help inform and continuously improve social investment programmes
  • Developing and implementing impact-led communication plans for internal and external stakeholders
  • Engaging leaders to create a shared vision and internal alignment on Shell Brazil social investment objectives and activities
  • Representing Shell externally and engaging with a broad range of stakeholders including communities, government, joint venture partners, civil society organisations, among others
  • Proactively identifying and managing risks to the social investment programmes, and identifying continuous improvement opportunities to ensure the programmes remain externally relevant, impactful, and efficient
  • Developing and coordinating the disaster response plans for supporting communities where needed
  • Ensuring compliance with Shell’s business principles, ethics, and compliance standards
  • Ensuring budget and activity planning and tracking progress, and compliance with Shell’s global reporting requirements for social investment spend and outcomes

What you bring

  • Must have legal authorization to work in Brazil on a full‑time basis for anyone other than the current employer.
  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field
  • 15+ years of experience with qualifications relevant to social development
  • Significant experience and proven track record in designing and delivering social development programmes, in particular related to STEM skills, enterprise development, and livelihood programmes
  • Experience working with corporates in designing and delivering social programmes with a good understanding of business processes and influencing senior business leaders
  • Extensive external network in the development sector to help create strong collaborations and partnerships
  • Experience managing external delivery partners
  • Experience in developing monitoring, evaluation, and learning frameworks; measuring and reporting impacts
  • Strategic and critical thinking skills to design and develop new programmes, and the ability to troubleshoot and solve problems
  • Strong communication (written and verbal), presentation, and facilitation skills; business fluency in English is a minimum requirement
  • Excellent collaboration, stakeholder influencing, and management skills across organizational boundaries and different levels of seniority, without direct authority
  • Ability to uphold high‑quality standards, anticipate and manage risks
  • Excellent project/programme management skills
  • Solid team leadership skills
  • Learner Mindset – role model curiosity and reflection, and encourage people to learn from mistakes and successes
  • Maximise performance – integrate and collaborate across boundaries to maximise commercial value for the organisation as a whole

What we offer

You bring your skills and experience to Shell and in return you work with talented, committed people on one of the most important challenges facing our planet. You’ll have the opportunity to develop the skills you need to grow in an environment where we value honesty, integrity, and respect for one another. You’ll be able to balance your priorities as you become the best version of yourself.

  • Progress as a person as we work on the energy transition together.
  • Continuously grow the transferable skills you need to get ahead.
  • Work at the forefront of technology, trends, and practices.
  • Collaborate with experienced colleagues with unique expertise.
  • Achieve your balance in a values‑led culture that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.
  • Benefit from flexible working hours, and the possibility of remote/mobile working.
  • Perform at your best with a competitive starting salary and annual performance‑related salary increase – our pay and benefits packages are considered to be among the best in the world.
  • Take advantage of paid parental leave, including for non‑birthing parents.
  • Join an organisation working to become one of the most diverse and inclusive in the world. We strongly encourage applicants of all genders, ages, ethnicities, cultures, abilities, sexual orientation, and life experiences to apply.
  • Grow as you progress through diverse career opportunities in national and international teams.
  • Gain access to a wide range of training and development programmes.

Shell is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

description:
Who We Are

At Kyndryl, we design, build, manage and modernize the mission‑critical technology systems that the world depends on every day. So why work at Kyndryl? We are always moving forward – always pushing ourselves to go further in our efforts to build a more equitable, inclusive world for our employees, our customers and our communities.

The Role

Join our team of passionate technology professionals dedicated to providing hands‑on support and maintaining systems for a wide range of end users, including executive support. As a Deskside Support Specialist , you’re more than a problem solver – you’re a true technology hero.

Key Responsibilities

  • Serve as the go‑to expert for testing and troubleshooting, identifying and resolving issues related to software upgrades, system imaging, and hardware deployments.
  • Provide support for hardware and software issues across multiple device types, both on‑site and remotely.
  • Ensure excellent customer service by meeting SLA and XLA targets.
  • Collaborate with internal Kyndryl teams and strategic partners such as Microsoft.
  • Identify opportunities for modernization and automation, presenting innovative ideas to enhance the end‑user experience and reduce costs.
  • Support projects involving the deployment of cutting‑edge technologies, ensuring a seamless experience for users.

Your future at Kyndryl

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands‑on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

Who You Are

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer‑focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Experience providing IT support.
  • Experience in Audiovisual.
  • Experience working in a customer‑facing environment.
  • Strong communication skills (email, phone, and in‑person).
  • On‑site support capability.
  • Fluent in Portuguese.

Preferred Skills

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical field.

Knowledge of popular operating systems and enterprise applications.

Workplace

Rio de Janeiro
São Paulo
Florianópolis
Recife

Being You

Diversity is a whole lot more than what we look like or where we come from, it’s how we think and who we are. We welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. But we’re not doing it single‑handily: Our Kyndryl Inclusion Networks are only one of many ways we create a workplace where all Kyndryls can find and provide support and advice. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you – and everyone next to you – the ability to bring your whole self to work, individually and collectively, and support the activation of our equitable culture. That’s the Kyndryl Way.

What You Can Expect

With state‑of‑the‑art resources and Fortune 100 clients, every day is an opportunity to innovate, build new capabilities, new relationships, new processes, and new value. Kyndryl cares about your well‑being and prides itself on offering benefits that give you choice, reflect the diversity of our employees and support you and your family through the moments that matter – wherever you are in your life journey. Our employee learning programs give you access to the best learning in the industry to receive certifications, including Microsoft, Google, Amazon, Skillsoft, and many more. Through our company‑wide volunteering and giving platform, you can donate, start fundraisers, volunteer, and search over 2 million non‑profit organizations. At Kyndryl, we invest heavily in you, we want you to succeed so that together, we will all succeed.

Get Referred!

description:
Static Mechanical Engineer - Relocate to Saudi Arabia, Permanent Expat Relocation Package

Full relocation to Saudi Arabia – permanent full-time Expat Relocation Package.

Job Overview: We are seeking a Plant Corrosion Engineer to join the Riyas Engineering Division (RNGLFD) which is part of the Riyas NGL Fractionation Dept (RNGLFD).

RNGLFD is responsible for two trains, each designed to process 255 MBOD (242.25 MBCD). Each train will include fractionation units, C3 & C4 treatment, C3 & C4 dehydration and propane refrigeration. The common facilities will include feed and product surge storage, chemicals storage and utilities including, but not limited to, steam and condensate recovery systems, utility water, plant, instrument air and nitrogen systems, machinery cooling water, drainage and flare systems. Some of the systems (e.g., steam headers, flare headers, product storage) have been pre-invested for the future train.

Your primary role will be to implement, support and continually improve RNGLFP inspection corrosion management programs and provide consolatory advice in materials, ensuring cost effective material selection and corrosion mitigation strategies, which will ensure mechanical integrity of the materials, applied on all plant assets including equipment and piping through their life cycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Implement corrosion management program and on-stream monitoring and Conduct risk-based inspection based on API-580 methodology.
  • Review and approve recommended solutions for coating failures and cathodic protection and participate in HAZOP review sessions and ensure that all issues are addressed.
  • Manage water treatment program and recommend solutions to overcome challenges and review design packages and validate materials selection based on current code and standards.
  • Validate corrosion controls corrosion controls, corrosion (CCD), corrosion loops and corrosion damage mechanisms frequently.
  • Assess FEED composition changes and approve recommended solution to assure assets integrity.
  • Develop scope and description of technology items, and lead field implementation.
  • Develop and transfer knowledge about use of coating, Cathodic protection (CP), corrosion inhibitors and other corrosion controls and best practices.
  • Extract data and draw conclusions from Corrosion Monitoring Technologies, and troubleshoot corrosion problems and address root causes.
  • Perform the regular review and update on the plants Integrity Operating Windows (IOW) and Corrosion loops drawings shall be updated by adding emerging damage mechanisms or removing damage mechanisms because of plant upgrades.
  • Adjust and modify inspection practices and programs shall be reflected based on such modifications and perform special studies in corrosion control. Evaluates data as to scope, impact and long-range cost effectiveness on existing and new projects.
  • Review operations and monitoring activities to identify needed system modifications or procedural changes associated with corrosion control with conduct corrosion mitigation and integrity review to optimize the inspection and corrosion programs and maintain assets integrity.

Qualification Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in engineering, preferably in mechanical engineer.
  • 15 years' experience processing in Oil/Gas Industry.
  • Demonstrate experience in material science and metrology, different NDT technology and their applications and knowledge in engineering aspect of welding.
  • Strong Knowledge of international standards and codes NACE, ASME, API and ASTM especially inspection and corrosion standards such as API-571, API-580, API-570 and API-510.
  • Valid NACE Specialist Certification or NACE Senior Corrosion Technologist or combination of NACE Corrosion Technologist, API-571 and NACE CP level II.

O Atacadão marca presença no ambiente digital por meio do seu e-commerce, com um próprio canal de vendas online mais direcionado a transformadores, comerciantes e empreendedores de pequenas, médias e grandes empresas, pela possibilidade de adquirir volumes maiores de itens, parcerias com aplicativos de entrega que atendem ao consumidor final, e também o Meu Atacadão, aplicativo que permite que os clientes encontrem ofertas diferenciadas enquanto fazem suas compras nas lojas físicas.

Tem como pilares de sustentabilidade o combate à fome e às desigualdades, a diversidade e inclusão e a proteção ao planeta e biodiversidade.

  • Implement McDermott processes and systems on projects.

  • Lead the set up and maintenance of the progress measurement system.

  • Lead project reviews conducted with the client and internal management.
  • Support the development and implementation of the Project Risk and Opportunity process.
  • Participate or lead the weekly and monthly cost and schedule review meetings.
  • Manage and maintain good client relations.
  • Actively look for areas of improvement on project and company standards.
  • Create Weekly / Monthly / Quarterly Reports.
  • Assist in resource planning, recruiting, mentoring, and evaluations.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or Construction Management is preferred or
  • Ten plus (10+) years of experience in Project Controls.

  • Experienced in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Project Management Professional is a plus.
  • Understanding of Cost and Progress management systems is a plus Work independently with little or no supervision.
  • Great communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken.

  • Understand the relationship between estimating, cost management, progress, schedule, and project accounting.

Atuar no desenvolvimento de projetos eletromecânicos de linhas de transmissão até 138kV, com foco em qualidade técnica, atendimento aos requisitos normativos e prazos contratuais.   • Dimensionar eletromecânica e elétrica da linha (condutores, para-raios, isoladores, espaçamentos, esforços de tração e flecha), incorporando critérios de amortecimento, vibração e fadiga.

  • Produzir desenhos executivos e detalhamentos (plantas, cortes longitudinais e transversais, arranjos, fixações, grampos, emendas).
  • Definir o sistema de aterramento das estruturas e condutores, malha de terra compatível com segurança elétrica e regulamentos.
  • Realizar compatibilização técnica com disciplinas complementares (civil, proteção, telecomunicações, automação), garantindo integração dos projetos.
  • Aplicar e garantir conformidade com normas nacionais e internacionais (ABNT, IEC, normas de concessionárias) e regulamentos setoriais.
  • Adaptar projetos conforme requisitos contratuais de clientes ou exigências de concessionárias / clientes, acompanhando revisões e solicitações.
  • Participar de reuniões técnicas com clientes, fornecedores, órgãos reguladores e equipes de obra para alinhamento de soluções, esclarecimento de dúvidas e decisões de projeto.
  • Acompanhar cronogramas de projeto, distribuir tarefas entre equipe de projetistas, revisar entregas, monitorar prazos e qualidade técnica.
  • Elaborar relatórios técnicos e gerenciais para acompanhamento de status do projeto, performance da equipe, indicadores de progresso e apoio à gestão.
  • Apoiar a execução da obra fornecendo suporte técnico, esclarecimentos de campo, checagem de conformidade entre projeto e execução e ajustes quando necessário.
  • Garantir que o projeto atenda requisitos de confiabilidade, manutenibilidade, durabilidade e segurança elétrica ao longo do ciclo de vida da linha.

Requisitos Técnicos

We are looking for a AI/ML Engineer Tech Lead Manager to act as one of the key leaders within our Data Science discipline. This role combines team management, hands‑on technical contribution and strong product partnership to ensure the delivery of high‑quality, scalable and business‑driven AI solutions.

The Tech Lead Manager will guide a team of Data Scientists, support planning and prioritization across initiatives and collaborate closely with Product and Engineering to drive clarity, alignment and iterative value delivery. This person will remain technically involved, contributing to experimentation, design decisions, and the development of robust end‑to‑end solutions while helping elevate standards and practices across the discipline. It’s also important to stay connected to emerging trends in AI and modern ML technologies.

  • Manage and support Data Scientists through coaching, feedback and structured team rituals.

  • Guide end‑to‑end solution development, ensuring scalability, maintainability and operational excellence.
  • Collaborate with other leaders to evolve shared frameworks, processes and best practices.
  • Promote a culture of iteration, incremental value delivery and continuous improvement.
  • Stay up to date with modern ML and AI trends, especially around LLMs and emerging technologies.

  • Lead the elaboration of research papers, technical publications and patent applications derived from the team's innovative AI methods and solutions, while safeguarding intellectual property.

Requirements

  • Degree in a STEM field (Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, etc.).
  • Experience leading Data Science teams or mentoring senior‑level Data Scientists.
  • Strong hands‑on expertise in AI, Machine Learning, Python and SQL.
  • Solid knowledge of ML frameworks such as Scikit‑Learn, TensorFlow, Keras, or PyTorch.
  • Proven experience designing, building and deploying ML solutions in production.
  • Excellent communication skills for engaging with technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Strong problem solver with ability to manage and lead the team to push solution & progress.
  • Experience working collaboratively with Product and Engineering organizations.

Title

Perinatal Sonographer

About the Role

We seek a dedicated professional with expertise in high-risk obstetric imaging to support the Maternal Fetal Medicine/Perinatology department at Howard University.   • Preferred one‑year OB experience or recent internship in obstetrics or MFM clinic; new graduates welcome.
  • Preferred Basic Life Support and CPR certification.Certification in nuchal translucency (NTQR or Fetal Maternal Foundation) or ability to obtain within 6 months of employment.

Competencies

  • Exceptional organizational and time‑management skills.
  • Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills.
  • Ability to work with limited supervision.
  • Meet national matrix standards for high‑quality patient care and diagnostic imaging services.

Work Environment & Physical Demands

Professional medical office setting, fast‑paced, diverse population, frequent exposure to contagious diseases and bodily fluids. Requires use of computers, phones, office equipment.

description:
Já pensou em fazer parte do crescimento da maior provedora de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal em todo o mundo? Todas as nossas ações convergem para um só objetivo: promover a saúde e o bem-estar do paciente. Queremos criar um futuro que vale a pena viver!
QUEM SOMOS:
A Fresenius Medical Care (FME) tem como propósito fundamental melhorar a vida dos pacientes com doença renal crônica (DRC), oferecendo-lhes um serviço integral, caracterizado pela mais alta tecnologia para o tratamento de diálise e o apoio permanente de uma equipe especializada, profissional e comprometida com a saúde do paciente.
Graças a este compromisso, a Fresenius Medical Care tornou-se a maior provedora mundial de produtos e serviços para pacientes com doença renal crônica, uma doença que afeta a mais de 3,2 milhões de pessoas em todo o mundo. Provemos serviços de diálise por meio de mais de 3.928 clínicas de diálise em todos os continentes, atendendo a mais de 333.331 pacientes.
Descrição :
Responsável por garantir o bom estado geral do paciente renal crônico em tratamento dialítico, colaborando na resolução de problemas psicológicos, trabalhando a autonomia e engajamento do paciente, respeitando sua individualidade.
Garantir a aderência do paciente renal ao tratamento dialítico, analisando e intervindo nas situações de não aderência, assim como nas situações de faltas às sessões de diálise.

  • O que você irá realizar
  • Entrevistar os pacientes novos na unidade, registrando os dados no prontuário do paciente ou meio eletrônico (somente serão registradas informações que tenham relevância ao tratamento dialítico);
  • Acompanhar o estado psicológico do paciente através de atendimento aos pacientes em diálise periodicamente, avaliando a pertinência de intervenções específicas e assistindo individualmente aqueles que necessitem;
  • Favorecer um ambiente adequado de diálise, a fim de propiciar a aderência do paciente ao tratamento, tornando o tempo de diálise em momento produtivo;
  • Trabalhar visando à integração entre pacientes;
  • Orientar os pacientes e familiares proporcionando o acesso envolvimento ao seu tratamento, por meio da educação continuada e juntamente equipe multidisciplinar;
  • Promover a integração da equipe multidisciplinar x pacientes e um apoio para as dificuldades encontradas no lidar com o paciente renal crônico através da realização de reuniões com a equipe de saúde;
  • Promover reuniões periódicas com pacientes, objetivando esclarecer dúvidas e orienta-los quanto às implicações emocionais e comportamentais no tratamento dialítico;
  • Analisar mensalmente relatórios de faltas de pacientes as sessões de diálise e realizar plano de ação visando melhorar a aderência do paciente renal a sessão;
  • Solicitar a presença de pacientes/familiares em eventos sociais auxiliando na promoção destes eventos juntamente com serviço Social;
  • Representar a ouvidoria do paciente junto à Unidade de Diálise e encaminhar reclamações/solicitações pertinentes aos setores competentes;
  • Garantir o registro das informações psicológicas do paciente através da confecção das evoluções periódicas no prontuário do paciente ou me meio eletrônico;
  • Participar de processos institucionais, programas e/ou projetos corporativos estabelecendo um relacionamento adequado com os clientes externos e internos;
  • Participar ativamente das reuniões técnicas, administrativas e multidisciplinares (Reuniões de Qualidade, PCPIEA, etc) da unidade visando melhoria continua dos resultados da unidade;
  • Participar de reuniões e resultados clínicos da unidade, visando à elaboração de plano de ação para situações (Relatório de faltas às sessões, problemas relacionados à não aderência, e outros);
  • Garantir a autorização para atuar na empresa através do cumprimento das obrigações legais mediante ao Conselho Regional de Psicologia assim como cumprir e fazer cumprir o código de ética e atendimento aos requisitos legais.
  • Esperamos que você tenha
  • Ensino Superior completo em Psicologia;
  • CRP ativo e regular;
  • Experiência prévia com atendimento clínico em Nefrologia;
  • Desejável especialização em Psicologia Clínica;

  • Local de trabalho: Rio de Janeiro

Na Fresenius oferecemos oportunidades iguais para todos os profissionais qualificados, independentemente de gênero, raça, deficiência ou qualquer outra característica; proporcionando respeito mútuo, ambiente saudável e motivador a todos.

title: Financial Systems Analyst
description:
Join to apply for the Financial Systems Analyst role at Conservation International

This position is based in Arlington, VA, Mexico, Brazil, Colombia, Ecuador, Bolivia, Peru, or Guyana.

Reporting to the Financial Systems Lead, this position supports CI’s current financial systems (Unit4 Business World and SAP Concur) and future systems, including a new cloud-based ERP system (Workday). The main focus is to support day‑to‑day operations by responding to help‑desk requests from system users globally and managing system security. This role also supports the generation of special financial and budget reports through SQL queries and advanced Excel applications as needed, and supports enhancement and development of existing and new applications, including design, data validation, testing, and training.

To be successful, you will need strong technical aptitude, experience as a user and a system manager, understanding of accounting and financial reporting, good customer service and communication skills, and the ability to triage and reprioritize case load. Patience with diverse user skill levels and determination to resolve issues timely are essential.

Responsibilities

  • Provide an approachable and responsive helpdesk service, supporting users of CI’s financial applications (Unit4 Business World and SAP Concur) globally.
  • Triage system issues/bugs raised by business users and work to find solutions.
  • Escalate complex issues as necessary, working with internal and external third parties to facilitate resolution.
  • Ensure timely follow‑up, resolution, and documentation of service requests.
  • Maintain financial system integrity, including setting up, administering, and terminating user accounts and maintaining complex workflow structures.
  • Support data quality checks and monitor changes to keep system records up‑to‑date.
  • Work with system providers and IT to facilitate installation and migration of software patches and upgrades.
  • Create and maintain system configuration to ensure optimal processing.
  • Assist in using, developing, and implementing financial system applications.
  • Support testing activities on finance projects, assisting with UAT for new systems, processes, and updates affecting finance operations.
  • Design special‑purpose reports for audits or other management uses.
  • Design processes and procedures for getting data into and out of financial systems as needed.
  • Maintain custom reports and forms in BW using BW report engine tools.
  • Maintain AG16s (SQL‑based customizations) in BW.
  • Participate in ad‑hoc tasks or projects as assigned by the supervisor.

Working Conditions

Guidance on flexible work arrangements will be shared during the interview process.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in a related field or equivalent experience.
  • 4‑6 years of related experience in providing support for financial systems as a super user or system administrator.
  • Understanding of accounting processes and standards.
  • Solid working knowledge of relational and/or OLAP databases.
  • Experience working with MS SQL Server.
  • Experience with ERP reporting tools, particularly Power BI.
  • Accuracy and strong attention to detail.
  • Analytical mindset.
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey financial or technical information to non‑financial/technical stakeholders.
  • Pro‑active problem‑solving approach.
  • Ability to plan own workload and resolve conflicting priorities, accountable for own actions.
  • Flexibility and adaptability.
  • Continually seeking ways to improve processes.
  • Passion, drive, and curiosity to challenge and ask questions.
  • English is the working language of the organization and this role.

Preferred

  • Experience with Business World Financials, including General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Purchasing, Timesheets, and reporting modules.
  • Familiarity with Unit4 BW reporting tools and SQL‑based customizations (AG16s).
  • Cloud‑based ERP system implementation experience (e.g., Unit4 ERPx, Microsoft Dynamics F&O, Workday).
  • Experience with Workday Financials, Adaptive, or other Workday products.
  • Experience with SAP Concur administration.
  • Experience in the INGO sector.
  • Foreign language fluency, especially Spanish, French, and Portuguese.

To apply

Please submit a resume, cover letter, and respond to the position‑based questions in your application.

description:
Process Engineer - Rio at Hanwha Ocean

Location: Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, RJ, BR

Requisition ID: 1286

Overview

Hanwha Ocean is undergoing a transformative journey, evolving from a traditional shipbuilder to an Engineering, Procurement, Construction, Installation, and Operation (EPCI(O)) solution provider, offering products such as FPSO, FLNG, Offshore Renewables and other Floating Production Units. The Energy Plant Unit is proud to announce the establishment of new Global Business Centers, marking a significant milestone toward becoming a project‑centric and client‑driven organization.

Position Overview

The Process Engineer leads and controls process engineering activities. The Principal Process Engineer performs checks and reviews all data requested by the Client for approval, provides assessments on the performance of engineers, and ensures that engineering work and deliverables in the process discipline are accurate and correct to code, standards, and project specifications. The role may require frequent travel to the US, Europe, and Asia.

Key Responsibilities

  • Understand project requirements, scope of work, and project schedule.
  • Supervise Senior and Junior Process Engineers from project start to finish.
  • Ensure all engineering documents are prepared and developed in accordance with relevant design codes, standards, and client specifications.
  • Provide engineering expertise and support or report to the Manager of Process to ensure engineering progress meets timelines.
  • Ensure process and utility systems are optimized, efficient, safe, and environmentally compliant.

Assist in Project in Bidding or FEED Stage

  • Provide engineering review and support for bid proposals, including estimate of man‑hour and cost.
  • Conduct feasibility studies and FEED verification.

Process Engineering

  • Develop process calculations, studies, and deliverables.
  • Review process simulation and results, including heat and material balances, for accuracy of calculations.
  • Review all process engineering packages and deliverables (Sizing, Calculation, Report, PFD, PID, etc.).

Participation in Various Workshops

  • Chair HAZOP, Vendor HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, Design Review, and others.
  • Lead engineers to close out comments/punches/recommendations from HAZOP, Vendor HAZOP, HAZID, SIL, Design Review, etc.
  • Manage and report status of comments/recommendations.

Control 3rd Party and Sub‑Contractor

  • For special process study, contract, and selection through technical evaluation of 3rd party.
  • Manage 3rd Party work scope and review, comment, and approve 3rd Party output.
  • Control subcontractor performance and check quality of diagrams from subcontractor.

Participation and Support for Commissioning and Startup

  • Develop/review relevant philosophies and procedures.
  • Provide engineering support for construction, commissioning, and operation teams.

Management of Engineering

  • Ensure that process engineering output aligns with project objectives, schedule, and budget.
  • Generate regular progress reports.
  • Report engineering outstanding and concerns to the Discipline Manager with technical summaries of outstanding issues.

Problem Solving and Addressing Engineering Concerns

  • Provide engineering expertise for decision making to resolve process‑related issues.
  • Address engineering punches and comments.

Coordination and Communication

  • Lead engineering meetings with client, engineering subcontractor, and generate MOM.
  • Coordinate with detailed engineering consultants or client, vendors, and subcontractors.
  • Manage interface with all relevant disciplines to get necessary information for process engineering or to provide data to other disciplines.
  • Raise technical queries, RFIs, and others to obtain necessary information/Client approval.
  • Provide clarification/answer to Client’s request.

Monitoring and Mentoring

  • Teach, instruct, and guide less experienced Process Engineers.

Qualifications

  • At least a Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Petroleum or Chemical Engineering.
  • Professional Engineer (PE) or equivalent certification is a plus.
  • Minimum of 10 years of relevant experience in process engineering in the offshore oil and gas industry.
  • Extensive knowledge of process engineering practices, principles, industry codes and standards, and an understanding of scientific methods of problem‑solving.
  • Proven track record of success in developing and performing Topsides Process Conceptual / Feasibility Studies during pre‑FEED/FEED or tender stage; prior experience with FPSO or FLNG design development and/or engineering project delivery (e.g., at a top‑tier FPSO contractor) is preferred.
  • Strong understanding of offshore industry terminology, concepts, and practices.
  • Knowledge of class rule, recognized code, standard, and skill of process engineering tools such as Aspen HYSYS, Flarenet, Pipe‑net or equivalent, and ability to interpret results of process simulation.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills.
  • Ability to work effectively independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team, with strong attention to detail and accuracy; ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Fluency in English.

Job Overview

The Principal Cost Controls Specialist interprets internal or external business issues and recommends best practices to improve cost and schedule. They will be tasked with solving complex cost management problems and will work independently with minimal guidance. The Principal Cost Controls Specialist may be required to guide junior personnel. As such, they must have in-depth expertise in costing and broad knowledge of the costing discipline within the project controls function.

Essential Qualifications and Education

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Business, Finance, Engineering, or Construction Management is preferred
  • Ten plus (10+) years of experience in Project Controls.
  • Must have experience in a large-scale mega-project in Oil & Gas and Offshore Construction.
  • Highly competent in the use of critical project management concepts such as EVM, project planning, risk analysis, and progress measurement.
  • Experienced in Microsoft Office applications.
  • Project Management Professional is a plus.
  • Understanding of Cost and Progress management systems is a plus.
  • Work independently with little or no supervision.
  • Great communication and presentation skills, both written and spoken.
  • Experienced in both Cost and Schedule with a focus on Cost Management.
  • Understand the relationship between estimating, cost management, progress, schedule, and project accounting.

Key Tasks and Responsibilities

  • Implement McDermott processes and systems on projects.
  • Lead the project controls team on large and highly complex EPC projects.
  • Implement constructability concepts, (the how it’s built) and related interdependencies between Engineering, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction in support of the Advanced Work Planning (AWP) process.
  • Support the development of the Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) on complex projects with multiple partners and compensation types.
  • Implement internal and contractual requirements on the project via the project controls execution plan.
  • Lead setup and implementation of project controls systems.
  • Responsible for the accuracy of project controls reports.
  • Analyze and interpret cost forecasting and trending.
  • Recommends solutions or recovery plans for problem areas.
  • Lead preparation and review of the project monthly forecast.
  • Support the Project Controls Team in development of the cost spread and cash flows.
  • Participate in proposal development, commercial alignment and project kickoff processes.
  • Supervise and train junior personnel in all aspects of cost reporting.
  • Lead the set up and maintenance of the progress measurement system.
  • Implement and support the Change Management process.
  • Lead change management efforts, including building of cost estimates and apply or manage amendments to the contract.
  • Lead project reviews conducted with the client and internal management.
  • Support the development and implementation of the Project Risk and Opportunity process.
  • Participate or lead the weekly and monthly cost and schedule review meetings.
  • Manage and maintain good client relations.
  • Actively look for areas of improvement on project and company standards.
  • Create Weekly / Monthly / Quarterly Reports.
  • Assist in resource planning, recruiting, mentoring, and evaluations.

A NTS (Nova Transportadora do Sudeste S/A – NTS) transporta gás natural por meio de um sólido sistema de gasodutos, conectando a região mais industrializada do Brasil com segurança e confiabilidade. São mais de 2.000 quilômetros de gasodutos ligando os estados do Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais e São Paulo ao gasoduto Bolívia-Brasil, aos terminais de GNL e às plantas de processamento de gás.

Nossos Valores:
  • Respeito à vida e ao meio ambiente: Nosso compromisso é com a segurança dos nossos funcionários e das comunidades e com a preservação do meio ambiente por onde passamos.
  • Integridade: Atuamos com transparência e comprometimento em todas nossas relações, nos pautando pela legalidade.
  • Foco em resultado: Não nos encantamos com sofisticações desnecessárias. Concentramos nossos esforços no alcance das metas e no foco em resultados.
  • Postura de dono: Olhar além do resultado imediato e tomar a melhor decisão para a empresa é uma atitude de todos os nossos funcionários.
Descrição da Vaga

Estamos em busca de um Engenheiro(a) de Implantação de Projetos Pleno que será responsável pela execução e gestão de obras na área de gás, como gasodutos, SCCs, pontos de entrega e recebimento, estações de compressão, entre outros. A atuação será voltada ao acompanhamento técnico e operacional das obras, garantindo segurança, qualidade, cumprimento de prazos e integridade dos ativos.

Responsabilidades
  • Gerenciar empresas contratadas na implantação das obras
  • Acompanhar a execução física e financeira dos projetos, priorizando segurança do trabalho e qualidade técnica
  • Oferecer suporte técnico às equipes contratadas, promovendo alta produtividade
  • Elaborar, revisar e consolidar documentos técnicos para contratação de serviços (memoriais descritivos, cartas-convite, RFPs, termos de abertura)
  • Definir estratégias de contratação alinhadas às prioridades da NTS e aos requisitos dos projetos
Requisitos
  • Formação superior em Engenharia
  • Experiência em execução e gerenciamento de obras, preferencialmente no setor de gás
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas de acompanhamento de cronogramas (MS Project, Excel, Primavera)

  • CNH ativa
Diferenciais
  • Experiência com elaboração de análise de risco
  • Conhecimento em sistemas de transporte por dutos ou áreas correlatas
  • Vivência com análise e gerenciamento de riscos

  • Pesquise sobre a NTS: Entenda a história, valores e missão da NTS. Visite o site oficial e leia notícias recentes.
  • Revisão de CV: Garanta que seu currículo esteja atualizado e reflita suas habilidades e experiências relevantes.
  • Prepare-se para perguntas: Pense em exemplos concretos de situações em que demonstrou suas habilidades e competências.
  • Conheça a vaga: Entenda as responsabilidades e requisitos da posição para alinhar suas respostas às expectativas da empresa.
Etapas do Processo Seletivo
  • Entrevista com time de Gente: Para discutir mais sobre a empresa, aderência à vaga e expectativas.
  • Entrevista com o Gestor e Business Partner: Para conversar sobre aspectos do dia a dia, conhecimento técnico e carreira.
  • Entrevista com as Interfaces: Coordenadores e clientes internos que terão contato próximo com a área.
  • Entrevista com os Coordenadores ou Gerentes da área: Última etapa para conhecer a liderança e alinhar expectativas finais.
Por que trabalhar conosco?

Na NTS, você encontra um ambiente dinâmico, inclusivo e acolhedor, onde as pessoas são valorizadas e têm espaço para crescer. Acreditamos no poder da diversidade, da colaboração e do desenvolvimento contínuo.
